Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

Location
Remote (United States or Canada), with some travel to client sites for QBRs, executive readouts and workshops.

The problem you’ll help solve
Enterprises are under pressure to transform with AI, but most don’t have a clear picture of how work actually gets done today, so it’s hard to know where AI will pay off. Skan gives them that picture. Our process intelligence and context layer shows how work really flows across people and systems. From there, we help customers decide where to transform, shape their AI roadmaps, and build AI agents that put those decisions into action.

None of that matters unless customers see the results. Value shows up when someone connects what Skan delivers to what leadership cares about (cost, capacity, customer experience, risk) and turns it into decisions and measurable outcomes. This role makes sure every customer can say clearly what Skan is worth to them.

The role
You’ll own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts in one or more industry verticals and be accountable for their success: the health of each relationship, the delivery of each program, and the value each customer gets from Skan. Over time, you’ll connect Skan to each customer’s broader AI and transformation goals, from process intelligence through to the AI agents we build with them.

You’ll report to a Practice Leader and work closely with Sales, Customer Success Managers (CSMs), and our delivery and engineering teams. You do whatever it takes to make your accounts successful. Sometimes that means bringing in the right people; often it means rolling up your sleeves and doing it yourself.

What you’ll do
Run the account
• Own delivery across your accounts: run the program cadence and governance, and work with cross functional teams so commitments are met
• Manage risks and escalations with customer and internal stakeholders, get to the root cause (adoption, sponsorship or value gap), and bring in your Practice Leader when needed
• Handle and resolve customer requests on your accounts

Customer relationships
• Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders up to the executive level, and set and manage their expectations
• Map the stakeholders across each account, build relationships beyond your day-to-day contacts, and earn introductions into new parts of the business
• Run QBRs and executive reviews framed around business outcomes, not product usage • Own customer satisfaction and make your accounts referenceable
• Connect customers with the right people across Skan, including Sales, Product, Field Engineering and Solution Engineering

Value and impact
• Build expertise in your customers’ processes and business problems, and in where Skan applies
• Use Skan’s process data to form a point of view, and bring findings and recommendations to customer leadership
• Apply Skan’s value frameworks to measure the impact customers get, and build account-level business cases for renewal and expansion
• Contribute to AI and transformation road-mapping alongside your Practice Leader, linking Skan to each customer’s priorities

Growth and retention
• Own retention and growth across your accounts
• Earn the next phase of work by delivering results, and partner with Sales on each expansion opportunity
• Spot where Skan can go further, from new process intelligence use cases to AI roadmap and agent opportunities
• Lead product demonstrations, discovery and product-awareness sessions for customers

Team contribution
• Coach and support the CSMs working on your accounts, and help recruit and onboard new team members
• Help improve how we onboard and enable customers, including onboarding processes, tutorials and other materials

What you’ll bring
Need to have
• Bachelor’s degree
• 10+ years of professional experience managing large enterprise relationships
• 5+ years working with enterprise clients at a SaaS company or consulting firm
• 5+ years of program and project management responsibility
• Experience coaching or leading others, and working closely with Field Engineering and Solution Engineering teams
• Experience delivering digital transformation initiatives
• 5+ years of experience in one or more industry verticals such as banking, financial services, insurance or healthcare • Experience building business cases or ROI analyses that customer stakeholders used to make decisions
• Comfortable presenting to senior executives

Nice to have
• Background in management consulting, value engineering/value consulting, or process excellence (Lean, Six Sigma, process mining)
• 2+ years of start-up experience
• Experience with process intelligence, automation or AI platforms

Who we’d love to hear from
Strong candidates could come from different paths: customer success or account management at an enterprise software company, value engineering, or consulting. What they share is real curiosity about the customer’s business, not just the product, and a drive to own outcomes rather than just advise on them.

Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate.
We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.


About the Role

We are looking for a senior commercial leader to own a portfolio of strategic healthcare accounts. This is not a traditional account management role. You are the executive sponsor, the commercial owner, and the trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders simultaneously.

You will carry a net revenue retention and expansion quota, with direct accountability for renewals, upsell, and new use-case development across your assigned book of business. You will partner with a cross-functional team — including delivery, value engineering, and solutions — to ensure customers realize measurable business outcomes from their investment in Skan, and you will serve as the primary voice of the customer internally.

The ideal candidate has managed large enterprise accounts at a B2B SaaS company or a leading Agentic provider, has deep familiarity with healthcare operating environments, and can hold credible conversations with COOs, CIOs, and CFOs about AI, automation, and transformation strategy. This is not a relationship-manager role — this is a quota-carrying commercial role where you are accountable for outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Account Strategy & Governance
  • Develop and execute multi-year account plans for each customer, aligning Skan's capabilities to the client's business objectives, transformation priorities, and operating model.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that connect Skan's impact to enterprise priorities and surface expansion opportunities across business units and geographies.
  • Maintain executive sponsor relationships at the COO, CIO, CFO, and Chief Transformation Officer level, ensuring Skan is embedded in the client's strategic agenda.

Renewal & Expansion
  • Own the commercial relationship end-to-end: forecast accuracy, contract negotiation, on-time renewals, and conversion of expansion opportunities.
  • Identify and develop upsell and cross-sell opportunities across new business units, geographies, and use cases — including claims automation, underwriting ops, compliance, and loan processing.
  • Carry a net revenue retention (NRR) and new ARR expansion quota across your assigned book of business.

Customer Outcomes & Risk Management
  • Partner with the cross-functional account team — delivery, value engineering, solutions — to ensure consistent and measurable value delivery against customer success criteria.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate account risk: adoption gaps, stakeholder transitions, competitive pressure, or delivery concerns.
  • Maintain high customer satisfaction, strong platform adoption, and sustained engagement throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Escalate and resolve issues quickly, working cross-functionally to protect and strengthen the customer relationship.

Internal Advocacy & Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Represent customer needs internally, influencing product, marketing, and services priorities to strengthen Skan's BFSI enterprise offering.
  • Partner with the partnerships team to identify and activate GSI and SI co-delivery opportunities within your accounts.
Key Metrics for Success
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR): Primary metric; target 150%+ NRR across assigned book of business.
  • Expansion ARR: Net new ARR generated from upsell, cross-sell, and new use-case development within existing accounts.
  • Executive Engagement: Depth and frequency of C-suite relationships maintained per account.
  • QBR Cadence & Quality: Quarterly business reviews delivered on schedule with documented ROI evidence and forward-looking expansion plans.
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account management or enterprise customer leadership at a B2B SaaS company or leading Agentic provider.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing large enterprise accounts with Fortune 500 healthcare clients.
  • Demonstrated success engaging and influencing C-suite executives (COO, CIO, CFO, Chief Transformation Officer) at global financial institutions, with experience navigating complex enterprise buying and governance environments.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience structuring, negotiating, and closing large enterprise agreements and managing accurate revenue forecasts.
  • Conversant in AI and data concepts; able to credibly engage technical stakeholders on models, data flows, and platform architecture at a working level.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience strongly preferred.
Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Own some of the most strategic BFSI enterprise relationships in the market, with a direct line to the C-suite at the world's largest financial institutions.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.

Compensation
The salary for this role is $325-375K OTE on a 60/40 split + uncapped commissions

Benefits
  • 100% coverage of Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Work From Home
  • Stock Option Plan

Role Description:
As Sr. ABM Program Manager, you design and run Skan AI's 1:1 ABM programs for existing customer accounts, turning them into expansion pipeline and stronger retention. You work inside the ABM framework, measurement standards, and budget management. You own the account plans, programs, and day-to-day coordination that make 1:1 programs work effectively at scale. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in account detail and can connect it to strategy, coordinating account executives, customer success, content, digital, field, and product marketing around the accounts that matter most.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and run 1:1 ABM programs for expansion accounts, from account plan through execution, optimization, and reporting.
  • Build account plans with account executives and customer success, covering buying-committee maps, whitespace, expansion plays, and sequencing. Submit plans and investment asks to marketing leadership for approval.
  • Partner with product marketing and content on account-specific messaging, business cases, and executive content.
  • Orchestrate multi-channel 1:1 programs: executive outreach, direct mail and gifting, in-person experiences, personalized content, and account-level paid support with the digital and paid team.
  • Work with field marketing to build executive dinners, roundtables, and customer programs into account plans.
  • Coordinate BDRs on buying-committee outreach within expansion accounts.
  • Manage the 1:1 ABM sub-budget and report spend against outcomes monthly.
  • Track account engagement and expansion pipeline using the measurement standards set with marketing operations, and flag accounts ready for sales action.
  • Deliver regular 1:1 performance updates to sales and marketing leadership with account trends and recommended changes.
  • Contribute 1:1 learnings to the wider ABM playbook, including tiering and 1:few programs.
Qualifications:
  • 6+ years in B2B marketing, with 3+ years focused on ABM in enterprise SaaS or tech.
  • Proven record running 1:1 ABM programs that drive expansion pipeline.
  • Deep understanding of buying-committee dynamics, account planning, and customer expansion motions.
  • Experience with executive events, roundtables, and gifting programs tied to account engagement.
  • Strong collaborator across account executives, customer success, BDRs, field, and product marketing.
  • Hands-on with HubSpot for account-level execution and tracking.
  • Analytical and organized, able to move between account strategy and campaign detail.
  • Clear communicator who turns account activity into useful insight.

Why Skan AI

As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

Role Overview

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.
We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.
With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

Key Responsibilities
Product Vision and Strategy
  • Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
  • Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
  • Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
  • Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

Product Execution and Delivery
  • Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
  • Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
  • Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
  • Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

Using AI in How You Work
We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.
  • Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
  • Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
  • Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
  • Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
  • Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
  • Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

Team Leadership
  • Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
  • Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
  • Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

Customer and Commercial Engagement
  • Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
  • Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
  • Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
  • Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
  • Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.

Qualifications and Experience
  • 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
  • You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
  • Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
  • Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insights, and what makes process KPIs meaningful to an enterprise buyer.
  • You understand how AI and ML get applied in operational intelligence products. Not just the theory. You have worked through the practical realities of model development, validation, and how insights actually reach end users.
  • You have shipped products used by large enterprises. You understand procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and what it takes to get something adopted at scale inside a Fortune 500 organization.
  • You have led product teams before. People grew under your management. You know how to give teams real ownership while keeping everyone pointed in the same direction.
  • You are technically credible. You can have a substantive conversation with engineers and data scientists about architecture decisions, API design, and data pipeline trade-offs without needing someone to translate.
  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically about what you use them for and what impact they have had. This is a real expectation, not a checkbox.
  • You communicate clearly across very different audiences, from a technical spec reviewed by engineers to a roadmap presentation in front of a board.
  • You can operate in ambiguous situations without becoming paralyzed. Fast-moving, early stage environments energize rather than frustrate you.

Education
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required. An MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline is a strong plus.

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months
  • You have built a product roadmap that the whole company believes in and that customers are genuinely excited about.
  • You have shipped meaningful improvements to the process intelligence platform that customers are using, talking about, and renewing because of. • The product team is operating well. People have clear ownership, they are growing in their roles, and there is a culture of honest feedback and continuous learning.
  • Skan's process intelligence story is sharper and more differentiated in the market. That is visible in customer conversations, analyst coverage, and competitive win rates.
  • You have introduced AI-assisted ways of working into how the team runs discovery, writes specifications, and tracks the competitive landscape. It has made a measurable difference.
  • People across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and leadership come to you when they need the product perspective. You have earned that trust through good judgment and clear communication.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist who loves to get their hands dirty. This is a deeply hands-on role; you will build and own ML models and data pipelines, work directly with large and messy real-world datasets, and be the go-to person when something breaks or doesn't make sense. You will also play a key guiding role for junior data scientists and analysts on the team, helping them grow through close collaboration, code reviews, and day-to-day technical direction.
You are not a manager, but you are a multiplier. The best candidate is someone who writes excellent code in the morning, helps a junior teammate unblock an issue in the afternoon, and debugs a tricky customer data problem before EOD, and finds all three equally satisfying.
What You'll Do
Hands-On Modelling & Algorithm Development
  • Build, train, evaluate, and improve ML models that power core Skan.ai features including but not limited to task detection, workflow segmentation, behavioral pattern recognition, process discovery, and variant analysis.
  • Own the full modelling lifecycle: data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning and validation.
  • Run disciplined experiments: define clear hypotheses, design evaluation frameworks, and present findings with statistical rigour.
  • Explore and apply techniques from deep learning, NLP, time-series analysis, and unsupervised learning to real process intelligence problems.
  • Write clean, well-tested, production-ready Python code that your teammates can maintain and build on.
Data Pipelines & Large-Scale Data
  • Design and build reliable data pipelines that handle high volumes of multimodal enterprise data such as screen telemetry, event logs, clickstreams, and structured process data.
  • Work hands-on with distributed data platforms (Spark, Databricks, or equivalent) to process, transform, and validate data at scale.
  • Own data quality at every step: define validation checks, detect drift, monitor pipeline health, and fix issues proactively.
  • Collaborate with engineering to optimise ingestion and feature generation workflows for speed, cost, and reliability.
Customer Issue Diagnosis & Production Support
  • Investigate and resolve data and model issues that surface in customer environments; trace root causes across pipelines, features, and model behaviour.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Solutions teams to understand unexpected outcomes and translate them into concrete technical fixes.
  • Build internal diagnostic tooling and dashboards that make it easier to spot and triage data anomalies and model degradation in production.
  • Document findings clearly so that patterns are captured and future issues are resolved faster.
Guiding & Mentoring Junior Team Members
  • Serve as the day-to-day technical guide for junior data scientists and analysts; answer questions, review code, pair on hard problems, and help them grow.
  • Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews that improve both the work and the person who wrote it.
  • Help junior teammates develop good habits: experiment tracking, reproducibility, clean data handling, and robust validation.
  • Run informal knowledge-sharing sessions: walkthroughs of new techniques, post-mortems on what went wrong, or deep-dives into a dataset.
  • Flag blockers and skill gaps to the Principal/Chief Scientist and help shape how the team grows technically over time.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with product and engineering to understand requirements, scope data work, and deliver on time.
  • Communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders; translate model outputs and data insights into plain language that drives decisions.
  • Contribute technical input to sprint planning and quarterly priorities; flag feasibility concerns early and propose alternatives.

What We're Looking For
Required
  • M.S. or B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 5–8 years of industry experience building and shipping data science or ML solutions in production.
  • Strong Python skills with clean, modular, testable code as a baseline expectation.
  • Solid experience with large-scale data processing using Spark, Databricks, or similar distributed frameworks.
  • Proficiency in at least two of: supervised/unsupervised ML, NLP, deep learning, sequence modelling, or process mining.
  • Experience diagnosing and fixing real-world data quality and model behaviour issues in production systems.
  • A genuine interest in helping junior colleagues grow; this should excite you, not feel like a tax on your time.
  • Clear, concise communication: you can explain a complex model or a data issue to an engineer, a PM, or a customer success manager without jargon.
Nice to Have
  • Exposure to process mining, RPA, workflow analytics, or enterprise operations intelligence.
  • Experience with MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar experiment tracking and model management tools.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, transformer-based models, or multimodal learning pipelines.
  • Prior experience in a product-focused startup or scale-up environment.

We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

  • Own data quality at every step: define validation checks, detect drift, monitor pipeline health, and fix issues proactively.
  • Collaborate with engineering to optimise ingestion and feature generation workflows for speed, cost, and reliability.
Customer Issue Diagnosis & Production Support
  • Investigate and resolve data and model issues that surface in customer environments; trace root causes across pipelines, features, and model behaviour.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Solutions teams to understand unexpected outcomes and translate them into concrete technical fixes.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with product and engineering to understand requirements, scope data work, and deliver on time.
  • Communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders; translate model outputs and data insights into plain language that drives decisions.
  • Contribute technical input to sprint planning and quarterly priorities; flag feasibility concerns early and propose alternatives.
What We're Looking For
Required
  • M.S. or B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 3–7 years of industry experience building and shipping data science or ML solutions in production.
  • Strong Python skills with clean, modular, testable code as a baseline expectation.
  • Solid experience with large-scale data processing using Spark, Databricks, or similar distributed frameworks.
  • Proficiency in at least two of: supervised/unsupervised ML, NLP, deep learning, sequence modelling, or process mining.
  • Experience diagnosing and fixing real-world data quality and model behaviour issues in production systems.
  • Clear, concise communication: you can explain a complex model or a data issue to an engineer, a PM, or a customer success manager without jargon.
Nice to Have
  • Exposure to process mining, RPA, workflow analytics, or enterprise operations intelligence.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, transformer-based models, or multimodal learning pipelines.
  • Prior experience in a product-focused startup or scale-up environment.

About Skan AI
Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution
At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI
We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

About the Role

Skan is looking for a Senior Architect Leader to build and lead its L2 function: the team that owns the deepest, most complex technical issues our customers face on Skan platforms. These issues span data quality and integrity, network connectivity, virtual assistants, API integrations, data correlation, application performance, data management, and more.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead a team of senior engineers, personally dive into the hardest problems, and act as the technical bridge between customers and Product Engineering. You will be the person who connects the dots across seemingly unrelated events, finds the true root cause, and makes sure the same problem does not happen twice.
We are looking for someone who is highly responsive, collaborative, and energetic, and who brings deep experience across application architecture, databases, data models, LLMs, API integration, and network connectivity.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership of the L2 Function

Build, lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of L2 engineers, setting clear expectations around ownership, responsiveness, and technical rigor. Define and continuously improve the L2 operating model, including escalation paths from L1, handoffs to Product Engineering, triage priorities, SLAs, and on-call coverage for critical issues. Track and report on key metrics such as time to resolution, escalation rates, recurrence rates, customer satisfaction, and backlog health, and use them to drive improvement.

Deep Technical Troubleshooting

Act as the senior-most technical escalation point for complex customer issues across the Skan platform, including:
  • Data quality and integrity: missing, duplicated, inconsistent, or corrupted data; data pipeline and ingestion failures.
  • Networking and connectivity: proxy, firewall, DNS, TLS/SSL, VPN, and endpoint-to-cloud connectivity problems in customer environments.
  • Virtual assistants and LLM-powered features: unexpected responses, accuracy or grounding issues, latency, prompt and context behavior, and model integration failures.
  • API integrations: authentication and authorization failures, rate limiting, payload and schema mismatches, and third-party system integration issues.
  • Data correlation: issues in how events, sessions, users, and activities are stitched together and interpreted across sources.
  • Application performance: slowness, resource contention, scaling bottlenecks, memory and CPU issues, and query performance.
  • Data management: storage, retention, migration, backup and restore, and configuration issues.
Analyze logs, telemetry, traces, metrics, database records, and configuration data to isolate problems quickly and accurately. Correlate multiple events across components, time windows, and customer environments to form and validate hypotheses and arrive at sound conclusions. Reproduce issues in controlled environments when needed, and provide clear workarounds to customers while permanent fixes are developed.

Collaboration with Product Engineering

Partner with Product Engineering to resolve critical bugs and production issues, providing well-documented, reproducible, and prioritized escalations. Participate in and, where appropriate, lead incident war rooms for high-severity issues, coordinating across engineering, operations, and customer-facing teams. Feed field insights back into the product roadmap, highlighting supportability gaps, recurring defects, and opportunities to improve observability, diagnostics, and resilience.

Root Cause Analysis and Prevention

Lead detailed Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) for significant and recurring issues, clearly documenting what happened, why it happened, its impact, and the corrective and preventive actions required. Drive proactive measures to prevent recurrence, such as monitoring and alerting improvements, configuration hardening, diagnostic tooling, automated health checks, and product fixes. Identify trends and patterns across tickets to get ahead of issues before customers report them.

Technical Decision-Making and Consensus Building

Drive technical decisions on complex and ambiguous issues by building consensus across engineering, product, support, and customer stakeholders. Present findings and recommendations clearly, backed by data, and navigate disagreements constructively toward the best outcome for the customer and the platform.

Knowledge Management

Lead the documentation of recurring issues and their fixes as high-quality Knowledge Base (KB) articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides. Establish standards and review processes for KB content to keep it accurate, searchable, and current. Use the knowledge base to enable L1 to resolve more issues independently and reduce escalations to L2.

Customer Engagement

Communicate directly with customer technical teams (IT, security, infrastructure, and data teams) during critical escalations, translating complex technical findings into clear explanations and action plans. Build trust with key customers through responsiveness, transparency, and follow-through.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, technical support engineering, or site reliability engineering, including at least 4 years leading technical teams.
  • Deep experience in application architecture, including distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native platforms, and enterprise SaaS.
  • Strong expertise in databases and data models, including SQL and NoSQL systems, query optimization, schema design, and data pipeline troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI-powered applications, including how virtual assistants and generative AI features are built, integrated, and debugged.
  • Solid understanding of API design and integration, including REST, authentication standards (OAuth, SAML, API keys, tokens), webhooks, and enterprise system integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of network connectivity and security, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, proxies, firewalls, load balancers, and enterprise network constraints.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex, multi-layer issues and to connect the dots across multiple events, systems, and data sources to reach well-supported conclusions.
  • Proficiency with log analysis, observability, and monitoring tools (for example Splunk, Datadog, ELK, Grafana, New Relic, or similar).
  • Demonstrated track record of conducting rigorous RCAs and driving preventive actions to completion.
  • Experience writing and maintaining technical documentation, KB articles, and runbooks.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both engineers and customer executives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with process intelligence, process mining, analytics, or enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with endpoint or desktop agents deployed in enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containers, and Kubernetes.
  • Scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar) for diagnostics and automation.
  • Experience with ITSM and support tooling (for example Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk, or Freshdesk).
  • Exposure to ITIL practices, incident management, and problem management frameworks.
  • Experience building a support or escalation function from the ground up in a high-growth company.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly responsive: acts with urgency when customers are impacted and keeps stakeholders informed.
  • Collaborative: works across teams with humility and builds strong partnerships with engineering and customer-facing groups.
  • Energetic and driven: brings positive energy, ownership, and persistence to difficult problems.
  • Analytical and curious: never settles for the symptom and keeps digging until the true root cause is found.
  • Consensus builder: influences without authority and aligns diverse stakeholders around sound technical decisions.
  • Calm under pressure: stays composed and structured during high-severity incidents.
  • Teacher and mentor: raises the technical bar of the team and shares knowledge generously.

We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

HELPFUL, NOT REQUIRED
  • Insurance claims or underwriting, banking operations, or healthcare revenue cycle depth.
  • Process mining, task mining, intelligent automation, or applied LLM and agent products.
  • Agent frameworks, managed model services, retrieval or evaluation tooling.

About the Role
We are looking for a Sr. BDR Manager to run Skan's inbound and outbound pipeline generation motion and the team behind it. You own the sourced pipeline number, the playbook that produces it, and the hiring, ramp, training, and coaching of the BDRs who execute it.

This is a hands-on first-line leadership role. You will interview candidates, sit in on calls, rewrite sequences that are not working, and prospect directly into the most strategic accounts while the team ramps. You will work with Strategic Account Directors on coverage and target account lists, with Marketing on campaign design, inbound routing, and follow-up standards, with Partnerships on partner-sourced introductions, with Sales Enablement on onboarding, and with Revenue Operations on the data, reporting, and workflows the team runs on.
The ideal candidate has 5-8 years in business development or enterprise sales, including at least 2 years hiring and managing a business development team, and ideally has built a program rather than inherited one.
Key Responsibilities
Pipeline Generation Ownership
  • Own the team's sourced pipeline target: qualified meetings held, accepted opportunities, and dollar value of pipeline delivered to Sales each quarter.
  • Set individual rep targets, manage weekly attainment, and forecast sourced pipeline with Sales leadership.
  • Prospect directly into the most strategic accounts, particularly while the team is ramping or a territory is uncovered.
Inbound & Outbound Playbook
  • Own the playbook for both motions: target account selection, persona messaging, sequence design, channel mix, cadence, and inbound qualification standards.
  • Set the standard for how much research sits behind each touch, and review outreach quality rather than activity counts alone.
  • Test messaging and sequences systematically, keep what produces meetings, and retire what does not.
  • Define what qualifies as a meeting worth a Strategic Account Director's time, and hold the team to that definition.
Hiring & Ramp
  • Build the BDR team: define the hiring plan, headcount phasing, and candidate profile with Sales leadership and People.
  • Own sourcing, interviewing, and closing candidates, and run a scorecard-based interview process that predicts who succeeds at enterprise prospecting.
  • Design the ramp plan: what a new BDR must know and demonstrate at 30, 60, and 90 days, and certify each hire against it.
  • Partner with Sales Enablement on company-wide onboarding, and own the role-specific training that sits on top of it.
  • Build the career path out of the BDR seat into closing and other customer roles, with explicit promotion criteria.
Training & Coaching
  • Own ongoing training for the team: account research, cold calling, discovery, inbound qualification, objection handling, and competitive positioning.
  • Run weekly one-on-ones, call reviews, and live coaching, with specific and documented feedback.
  • Build a coaching plan for each rep against named skill gaps, and track whether the gap actually closed.
  • Manage performance against explicit standards, address underperformance early and directly, and retain the reps who are working out.
Territory Coverage & Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Partner with Strategic Account Directors and Sales leadership on named account lists, coverage, and prioritization.
  • Work with Marketing on campaign design, inbound lead routing, follow-up standards, and response times.
  • Coordinate with the Partnerships team on partner-sourced and partner-influenced introductions.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations on CRM data quality, pipeline generation reporting, and pipeline definitions.
Key Metrics for Success
  • Sourced Pipeline: Dollar value of qualified pipeline generated by the team each quarter across inbound and outbound, against target.
  • Qualified Meetings Held: Qualified meetings held by the team with target accounts.
  • Meeting-to-Opportunity Conversion: Percentage of held meetings accepted as opportunities by Sales.
  • Rep Attainment: Percentage of BDRs hitting individual target each quarter.
  • Ramp Time & Certification: Average time for a new BDR to reach full productivity, and percentage certified on schedule.
  • Hiring Plan Attainment: BDR hires made against headcount plan and timeline.
  • Retention & Internal Promotion: Team retention and number of BDRs promoted into closing or senior roles.
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 5-8 years in business development, inside sales, or enterprise sales, including 2+ years directly managing an outbound team at a B2B SaaS company.
  • Track record building a team and a pipeline generation program across inbound and outbound: hiring, ramp, target account strategy, messaging, sequence design, qualification standards, and the reporting behind it.
  • Experience with enterprise outbound into Fortune 500 accounts and senior operating stakeholders (COO, CIO, transformation and automation leaders).
  • Demonstrated hiring record: you have sourced, interviewed, and closed BDRs, and can point to reps you hired who were promoted into closing roles.
  • Experience designing ramp plans, certification standards, and ongoing coaching programs for early-career reps.
  • Hands-on with CRM (Salesforce or equivalent) and the prospecting stack, and comfortable building automated or agentic workflows into the pipeline generation motion.
  • Strong analytical skills; you can tell a targeting problem from a messaging problem from an activity problem.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience a plus.

Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Build Skan's pipeline generation engine, and the team behind it, from the ground up.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.
Benefits
  • 100% coverage of Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Work From Home
  • Stock Option Plan

About Skan AI
Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution
At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI
We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

About the Role
We are looking for a Business Development Representative to generate qualified pipeline in Skan's target enterprise accounts: large banks, insurers, healthcare systems, and technology firms. You own the first conversation, whether it starts with your outreach or with an inbound request. You research the account, build a point of view worth a senior executive's time, run the outreach across channels, and qualify well enough that the meeting you set is a meeting a Strategic Account Director wants to take.
Depth is the standard. Every touch should carry real research behind it, and every account you work should get sustained, multi-threaded attention rather than a single pass. The people you are reaching are COOs, CIOs, heads of transformation, and automation leaders at Fortune 500 companies, and they respond to precision about their own operation. Inbound requests get the same treatment: fast response, the same research, the same qualification bar. You will work directly with Strategic Account Directors on named account plans, with Marketing on campaign and content follow-up, and with the Partnerships team on partner-sourced introductions.
The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of business development experience at a B2B SaaS company covering both inbound qualification and outbound prospecting, has worked large enterprise accounts with long sales cycles, and is comfortable on the phone with senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Inbound & Outbound Pipeline Generation
  • Run targeted outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, and video into named Fortune 500 accounts across BFSI, healthcare, and technology.
  • Work inbound interest from campaigns, events, content, and website requests: research the account, qualify, and convert it into a meeting.
  • Generate qualified meetings that convert into sourced pipeline for Strategic Account Directors.
  • Stay with an account across multiple touches, channels, and stakeholders instead of dropping it after one sequence.
Account Research & Messaging
  • Research each target account to understand its operating model, transformation priorities, and likely process pain before the first touch.
  • Write account-specific messaging that speaks to what a COO, CIO, or transformation leader is actually trying to fix.
  • Multi-thread across business units and personas within each account, including operations, transformation, automation, and IT.
Qualification & Handoff
  • Run initial discovery calls to qualify fit, pain, timing, and stakeholder authority against Skan's ICP and qualification criteria.
  • Document what you learned so the Strategic Account Director walks into the next meeting fully briefed.
  • Hold the standard for what counts as a qualified meeting, and protect the time of the sales team.
CRM Discipline & Tooling
  • Keep account, contact, and activity data accurate and complete in the CRM.
  • Use the prospecting stack (sequencing, intent, enrichment, conversation intelligence) and the agentic workflows built for pipeline generation.
  • Give structured feedback on which personas, messages, and sequences are producing meetings so the playbook improves.
Key Metrics for Success
  • Qualified Meetings Held: Number of qualified meetings held with target accounts each month and quarter.
  • Sourced Pipeline: Dollar value of qualified opportunities sourced and accepted by Sales.
  • Meeting-to-Opportunity Conversion: Percentage of held meetings that convert into accepted opportunities.
  • Account Penetration: Number of target accounts with active, multi-threaded engagement across personas and business units.
  • Outreach Quality & Speed to Lead: Depth and relevance of the research behind each touch, and response time on inbound requests and marketing-generated leads.
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 1-3 years in a business development or similar role at a B2B SaaS company, covering both inbound qualification and outbound prospecting.
  • Experience prospecting into large enterprise accounts with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders.
  • Comfortable cold calling and holding a substantive conversation with senior operators (COO, CIO, VP Operations, transformation and automation leaders).
  • Strong written messaging skills: short, specific, and relevant to the account.
  • Hands-on with a modern prospecting stack (Salesforce or equivalent CRM, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) and comfortable using AI tools in daily research and outreach.
  • Organized, coachable, and consistent; you run your day against a plan.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience a plus.
Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Open the first conversation with senior leaders at some of the largest enterprises in the world.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.
Benefits
  • 100% coverage of Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Work From Home
  • Stock Option Plan

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

Role Description
Reporting to the Head of Growth Marketing, this pivotal role is responsible for driving brand visibility and qualified traffic through traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms. It's a high-impact, hands-on position focused on ensuring Skan AI's content, brand, and solutions are discovered, cited, and recommended by both Google and AI search platforms — building a sustainable engine for organic discovery that delivers measurable pipeline impact.

You'll develop and execute strategies to optimize Skan AI's content and technical infrastructure for maximum visibility in traditional search and AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, and others), owning everything from technical optimization and content strategy to performance analysis. This role is ideal for a self-starter who thrives in the details but also connects the dots at a strategic level. You bring deep expertise in how both traditional search engines and AI systems surface and cite information, with a passion for accelerating growth in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own the strategy, planning, and execution of Skan AI's SEO and AEO/GEO programs to maximize visibility across traditional and AI search platforms and LLM-generated responses.
  • Identify high-impact search queries and AI prompts in target markets, then optimize content architecture and structured data to maximize visibility in both traditional search rankings and AI citations.
  • Partner with product marketing and content teams to ensure alignment on ICP targeting, messaging hierarchy, and answer-ready content formats.
  • Equip content teams with data-driven insights on high-impact queries, competitor positioning in AI responses, and content gaps.
  • Design and implement schema markup strategies (FAQs, HowTos, Q&As, Organization, Product) to improve AI platform recognition and citation.
  • Collaborate closely with demand generation to ensure AI-driven organic traffic converts efficiently through optimized landing pages and nurture paths.
  • Build and optimize scalable workflows for content optimization, ensuring domain authority, entity clarity, and citation-worthy formatting across all owned properties.
  • Work with marketing ops to build and maintain performance dashboards tracking AI visibility, citation frequency, traffic quality, and pipeline attribution from AI-driven channels.
  • Deliver regular performance updates to senior leadership, sharing insights on AI search trends and actionable recommendations for improving organic discovery.
  • Manage budget allocation for tools, content production, and experiments to ensure every dollar drives maximum visibility and revenue impact.

Qualifications & Skills
  • 6-8+ years of SEO and content strategy in fast-paced B2B SaaS or tech environments, with AEO/GEO experience.
  • Exceptional content instincts with the ability to craft, edit, and optimize compelling copy that resonates with both AI systems and human buyers.
  • Proven track record of improving brand visibility in SEO and AI-generated responses and featured snippets across multiple platforms.
  • Demonstrated success in driving organic traffic growth that converts to qualified pipeline and revenue.
  • Experience in optimizing for AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, and others.
  • Deep understanding of structured data implementation, entity SEO, and how LLMs retrieve and cite information.
  • Strong technical proficiency with headless CMS platforms (Sanity) and hands-on experience implementing on-page optimizations, schema markup, and technical SEO improvements.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript sufficient to implement and troubleshoot technical changes without heavy developer dependency.
  • Expertise with tools like Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and AI visibility tracking tools (Profound, Scalenut, and similar tools).
  • Experienced in configuring tracking on website using Google Tag Manager and UTMs.
  • Strong collaborator with content and product marketing teams to align on strategy and ensure flawless execution.
  • Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, able to balance strategic thinking and hands-on technical execution.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with a proven ability to identify patterns in AI search behavior and optimize accordingly.
  • Excellent communicator with the ability to translate complex technical concepts and present actionable, data-driven insights to senior leadership.

About Skan AI
Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution
At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI
We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

ROLE SUMMARY
The Lead DevOps Engineer designs, builds, and maintains the CI/CD pipelines, deployment tooling, and infrastructure automation that power Skan's customer delivery operations. Working within the Customer Ops team, this role is the engineering engine behind deployment velocity — ensuring that customer environments are provisioned, upgraded, and maintained reliably, securely, and at pace.
This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and infrastructure operations. The DevOps Engineer is responsible for making deployment a repeatable, automated, and quality-assured activity — eliminating manual overhead, enforcing DevSecOps standards, and giving the wider Customer Ops and Systems Engineering teams the tooling they need to operate efficiently at scale.
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
As Skan's enterprise customer base grows, so does the complexity of managing deployments across cloud-hosted, customer-hosted, and hybrid environments. Without dedicated DevOps engineering, deployment activities are manual, inconsistent, and slow — creating delivery risk, increasing the chance of environment-related incidents, and preventing the Customer Ops team from scaling without linear headcount growth.
The DevOps Engineer provides the automation and tooling layer that makes Skan's customer delivery operations scalable, auditable, and professionally run — directly supporting SLA commitments, deployment quality, and time-to-value for enterprise clients.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for customer environment deployments, upgrades, and patch cycles — covering cloud-hosted and customer-hosted models
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Helm, Ansible)
  • Implement and enforce DevSecOps practices across all product and client deployment pipelines — including security scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code controls
  • Develop and maintain deployment tooling, scripts, and environment templates that reduce manual effort and improve deployment consistency
  • Support Systems Engineers during new customer environment builds, patch cycles, and major upgrades — providing tooling, automation, and hands-on assistance
  • Build and maintain ops process tooling: SLA tracking dashboards, deployment status portals, environment health monitors, and internal reporting utilities
  • Maintain deployment metrics and reporting — pipeline success rate, deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate — to inform continuous improvement
  • Identify and remediate deployment bottlenecks, pipeline failures, and infrastructure configuration drift across customer environments
  • Collaborate with the SRE team to align infrastructure design with operational monitoring and incident response requirements
  • Participate in change management processes — ensuring all production environment changes are logged, reviewed, and reversible
  • Contribute to the Automation Engineering team's agentic workflow initiatives — developing automation that further reduces operational toil
  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for all pipelines, playbooks, and environment configurations
KEY DELIVERABLES
  • CI/CD pipeline designs and live implementations for all customer deployment models — cloud, on-prem, and hybrid
  • Infrastructure-as-Code templates and reusable deployment playbooks — maintained, versioned, and documented
  • DevSecOps controls documentation and compliance evidence for all customer-facing pipelines
  • Automated environment provisioning and teardown scripts — reducing manual setup time per new customer deployment
  • Deployment metrics dashboard: pipeline success rate, deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate — reported monthly
  • Ops tooling: SLA trackers, status portals, and environment health dashboards operational and actively used by Customer Ops teams
  • Target: pipeline success rate ≥ 95%; zero unplanned production outages attributable to deployment tooling failures
KEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS
  • CI/CD platforms: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps — pipeline design, implementation, and maintenance at enterprise scale
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm, Ansible — provisioning, configuration management, and drift detection
  • Container platforms: Docker and Kubernetes — build, deployment, and runtime management in production environments
  • DevSecOps: security scanning (SAST/DAST), secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or equivalent), policy-as-code (OPA, Sentinel)
  • Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP — provisioning, networking, IAM, and cost-aware infrastructure management
  • Scripting and automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell — automating deployment workflows and operational tasks
  • Monitoring integration: ability to instrument pipelines with observability hooks compatible with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent
  • Change management: familiarity with ITSM processes and structured change control in enterprise environments
  • Collaboration skills: able to work effectively with Systems Engineers, SRE, and customer-facing teams in a fast-moving environment
  • Documentation: clear, maintainable runbooks and pipeline documentation — written for both technical peers and operational teams

This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with an expectation to work from the office three days a week.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate.
We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

About the Role
Skan AI is one of the category leaders defining the agentic AI era — combining process intelligence with autonomous agents through the Skan Trifecta: Blueprint, Intelligence, and Agents. This role sits closer to enterprise-level decision-making than most roles at this career stage typically allow: direct, daily partnership with the CCO, visibility into strategic decision making process, and a front-row seat to how a fast-growing AI company scales its customer function. It's a role built for someone who wants to learn how a company is actually run at the executive level — not just report on it.

The role itself is the CCO's decision-support system — the person who turns customer health, delivery health, cost-to-serve, and NDR performance into what the CCO and the leadership team actually act on. It doesn't run the CS org; it makes the CCO better at running it, by owning the data, the models, and the operating cadence that decisions get made against.

It's also the CCO's proxy in cross-functional forums where the customer KPI's need to be represented with authority — and the person who drives the CCO's strategic initiatives to completion across a leadership team that doesn't report to this role.

Key Responsibilities
1. CCO Decision Support & Executive Intelligence
  • Synthesize customer health, delivery health, cost-to-serve, and NDR data into what the CCO needs to walk into any room and make the call
  • Support the CCO with board and QBR materials — key data, analysis and outcomes
  • Represent the CCO's data-backed point of view in cross-functional executive forums — Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing
  • Own renewal forecast visibility and pipeline risk reporting so the CCO sees exposure before it becomes a surprise
2. Customer Health, Risk & Retention Economics
  • Own the customer health and risk model — signal selection, weighting, and correction based on churn postmortems
  • Own the NRR, GRR, and cost-to-serve economics that explain why the numbers move, not just that they moved
  • Own capacity and coverage modeling — accounts per resource by segment, tier, and complexity — to support resourcing calls
3. Operating Cadence Across the Leadership Team
  • Support the CCO with OKR reporting across Customer Success, Professional Services, and Support leadership — translating the CCO's priorities into a cadence the whole leadership team runs against
  • Ensure reporting logic is documented, reproducible, and auditable
4. Voice of Customer & Platform Enablement
  • Run the Voice of Customer program — structured feedback loops that feed product roadmap and GTM priorities, backed by data rather than anecdote
  • Own the CS tooling and platform roadmap, including how AI agents and modern tooling get adopted inside the CS organization itself
5. Strategic Initiatives & Execution Direction
  • Support the CCO with key initiatives that cut across the leadership team — operating model changes, segmentation shifts, M&A integration — to closure
  • Direct India-based analytical support on the underlying data production so you stay focused on the analysis and the decisions, not the pulls
  • Take on ad hoc strategic analysis — pricing, packaging, competitive questions — as they arise

Position Requirements
  • 8+ years of experience in Strategy, Business Operations, Revenue Operations, and/or Customer Success Operations within a high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise software company
  • Management consulting experience with a top-tier consulting firm
  • Demonstrated ability to build and own an operating cadence across a multi-function leadership team, not just one team
  • Owned a health/risk model and retention economics (NRR, GRR, cost-to-serve) end to end
  • Executive communication: has produced board-level materials
  • Comfortable directing analytical support and leading through influence across peers who don't report to you
  • Strong command of CRM, CS platforms, and analytics/BI tools; advanced Excel and SQL
  • MBA from a top program strongly preferred

Success Metrics
  • CCO Leverage: measurable increase in the CCO's time available for external stakeholders and long-term strategy, not spent producing or defending numbers
  • NDR Impact: retention and expansion trends demonstrably informed by the models and interventions this role drives
  • Cross-Leadership Execution: CCO-sponsored initiatives land on time across a leadership team this role doesn't manage
  • Decision Quality: leadership decisions across CS, delivery, and cost-to-serve are traceably better because of the intelligence this role produces

Benefits
  • 100% coverage of Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Work From Home
  • Stock Option Plan

We are looking for a Deal Desk Lead to own deal process, pricing, and the RFP/RFI response process for Skan's go-to-market organization. This role is the single point of accountability for how deals move from opportunity to signature: structuring and reviewing deal terms, governing pricing and discounting against established guardrails, and owning RFP/RFI responses from intake through submission.

Key Responsibilities
Deal Process & Structuring
  • Own the end-to-end deal desk process, from opportunity structuring through contract handoff, serving as the primary point of contact for reps on non-standard deals.
  • Review and approve deal terms — pricing, discounting, contract length, and payment terms — against established guardrails.
  • Design and maintain the deal approval workflow, including escalation paths for exceptions that fall outside standard guardrails.
  • Partner directly with Legal and Finance on deal-specific terms that require review outside the standard approval chain.
Pricing Governance
  • Own pricing structure and discounting policy for the GTM organization, ensuring consistency across segments and deal types.
  • Maintain and evolve pricing guardrails, approval thresholds, and discount tiers as the business and product portfolio evolve.
  • Track deal-level pricing and discounting trends and flag patterns that signal a need for policy change.
  • Maintain the pricing configuration in the quoting/CPQ system and ensure it reflects current approved rate cards.
RFP & RFI Response Ownership
  • Own the RFP/RFI response process end-to-end: intake, timeline management, response assembly, and final submission.
  • Build and maintain a response content library (security, technical, and commercial answers) so responses can be assembled quickly and consistently.
  • Coordinate subject-matter input from Security, Product, Legal, and Sales on response sections outside deal desk's direct expertise.
  • Continuously refine response quality based on win/loss outcomes and evaluator feedback.
Systems, Tooling & Reporting
  • Own configuration and administration of the deal desk's core tooling (CPQ and RFP response platforms).
  • Build and maintain reporting on deal cycle time, approval turnaround, discount trends, and RFP win rates.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that reduce deal friction and approval turnaround time.
Key Metrics for Success
  • Deal Cycle Time: Average time from deal desk submission to final decision.
  • Pricing Guardrail Adherence: Percentage of deals closing within standard pricing guardrails versus requiring an exception.
  • RFP/RFI Win Rate: Win rate on RFP/RFI submissions and percentage of responses delivered on time.
  • Content Library Coverage: Breadth and freshness of the RFP response content library relative to current product and security posture.
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 5-7 years of experience in deal desk, sales operations, or a closely related commercial function at a B2B SaaS company.
  • Direct, hands-on experience owning pricing governance and deal approval workflows in a growing sales organization.
  • Experience owning or heavily contributing to the RFP/RFI response process, including proposal assembly and content libraries.
  • Working knowledge of CPQ and quoting tools; comfort configuring and administering deal-related systems.
  • Strong judgment on when to hold a line on pricing and when to route an exception — comfortable being the point of friction on a deal when it's warranted.
  • Excellent written communication; RFP responses reflect directly on the company and need to read that way.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience a plus.
Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Directly shape how Skan structures, prices, and wins deals across the go-to-market organization.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.
Benefits
  • 100% coverage of Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Work From Home
  • Stock Option Plan

Location Requirement: Candidates must currently reside in the United States and be eligible to work in the U.S. to be considered for this role.
