About Skan AI
Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution
At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.
Why Skan AI
We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.
About the Role
Skan AI Agents ships into some of the most complex, regulated workflows in the enterprise, claims adjudication, underwriting, loan operations, compliance. We need a Principal Product Marketing Manager who will define how Skan AI talks about agentic AI as a category, not just launch individual features, while maintaining the technical fluency to earn credibility with engineering, sales, and the enterprise buyers evaluating whether an agent is actually ready for production.
Here's the distinction at the center of that story: deploying an agent isn't the hard part anymore, everyone's doing that. Operationalizing it, reliably and safely enough to run claims or underwriting in production, is. That's the argument you'll be sharpening and telling, across every audience that needs to hear it.
This role sits at the intersection of technical product understanding and go-to-market strategy, you'll embed deeply with the Agents product team to shape the roadmap's story, then set the positioning and launch strategy that marketing, sales, and customer success build on. You'll own the narrative for Skan AI Agents end to end, with the latitude to define how it's positioned.
Responsibilities
  • Strategic Positioning & Messaging
    • Define and own the positioning strategy for Skan AI Agents and the category narrative for agentic AI at Skan AI overall
    • Develop crisp, technically accurate messaging that translates Agents' capabilities, deterministic-first execution, governed reasoning, full auditability, into clear value for CIOs, Chief AI Officers, and operations leaders
    • Keep Agents' positioning grounded in the Context Graph of Work and consistent with Skan AI's broader platform narrative
  • Launch Orchestration
    • Own the end-to-end launch process for Agents features and capabilities, from early roadmap discussions with product and engineering through post-launch analysis
    • Build and maintain launch calendars, coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, and ensure consistent messaging across every channel
  • Content & Sales Enablement
    • Build a content portfolio spanning thought leadership, solution briefs, web copy, and whitepapers that speaks credibly to both technical and business buyers
    • Create competitive battle cards, demo scripts, and objection-handling materials that help sales articulate why Agents performs in production where other approaches stall in pilot
    • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to build reference stories and proof points from real deployments
  • Competitive Intelligence
    • Monitor the fast-moving agentic AI landscape to inform positioning and sharpen differentiation as the competitive set continues to shift
    • Translate competitive shifts into concrete messaging and sales-facing guidance
  • Qualifications
    • 7+ years of experience in product marketing, with demonstrated Principal-level ownership of positioning and strategy.
    • Meaningful time in technical, developer-adjacent, or platform/API product marketing
    • Demonstrated ability to work directly with product and engineering teams, translating technical capability into business value for enterprise buyers
    • Strong project management skills, with experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder launches
    • Exceptional written communication, particularly clear, precise technical messaging
    • Experience building sales enablement, competitive positioning, and demo materials
  • Nice to Have
    • Engineering background, technical degree, or prior hands-on technical role
    • Experience marketing to enterprise buyers in banking, insurance, or other regulated industries
    • Familiarity with agentic AI, process intelligence, or automation platform categories
    • Experience partnering directly with engineering or applied AI teams

Not all strong candidates will meet every qualification listed. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesn't match every bullet point above.

About Skan AI
Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution
At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI
We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

Putting Customers Center Stage
A quarter of the Fortune 50 and seven of the ten largest U.S. banks already run on Skan AI, and we’re just getting started.  Every one of those customers has a story to tell. This isn't a traditional customer marketing role focused solely on case studies. You'll own the entire journey, from a customer's first real result, through the moment they're willing to say so publicly, to becoming the voice that helps close the next deal.

Why This Role, Right Now
We're building this function almost from scratch, at exactly the moment we have the most raw material to work with. We just closed our Series C, and the momentum is real. Customers are already telling us, unprompted, exactly the kind of things that help the next one understand what's possible. Right now, most of it is underused.
AI is noisy right now, and in large, regulated industries, getting the narrative right matters more than getting it loud. You'll need the judgment to know which story, at which moment, actually moves a skeptical buyer.
You'll build the programs, relationships, and infrastructure to change that, with the full weight of a recent, high visibility launch behind you.
Responsibilities
  • Customer Community & Advocacy
    • Build and nurture relationships with customers to foster authentic advocacy, not manufactured testimonials
    • Partner with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to identify customers finding real value, and guide them from early success toward public advocacy while navigating internal stakeholder alignment and approvals along the way
    • Develop account-level advocacy plans that map priority customers to the right story, format, and moment
    • Stand up and run a customer advisory board, giving our most engaged customers a real voice in product direction and go-to-market
    • Bring customers and partners together, creating co-marketing moments, joint events, and shared stories that show the strength of the full ecosystem.
  • Storytelling & Content
    • Own the customer storytelling program end to end: identification, development, production, and distribution
    • Create case studies, video, and campaign content that help the market understand faster what's actually possible, grounded in what real customers have already figured out
    • Work with Communications to shape and time customer announcements, turning deployments and expansions into coordinated press, content, and social moments
  • Sales & Revenue Enablement
    • Guide Sales on how to use customer stories and references effectively to accelerate deals
    • Build and maintain a reference program that matches the right customer voice to the right prospect conversation
  • Programs & Platforms
    • Stand up customer loyalty and advocacy programs from the ground up
    • Own Skan AI's presence on G2 and similar review platforms, driving review generation, managing ratings and profile content, and using reviews as a source of customer proof and competitive positioning
  • Qualifications
    • 8+ years of experience in customer marketing, ideally at an enterprise technology or AI company
    • Exceptional writing and strategic narrative skills and shaping which story matters, with a track record of turning customer wins into stories that drove real business outcomes
    • Experience building relationships with technical executives and business leaders at large enterprises
    • A track record of guiding customers from early success to public advocacy, including navigating legal and brand review
    • Judgment for narrative discipline in noisy, high-stakes markets and knowing which story earns trust with a regulated-industry buyer. Comfortable building programs and infrastructure from the ground up
  • Nice to Have
    • Experience in banking, insurance, or other regulated industries
    • Experience standing up customer advisory boards or executive event programs
    • Experience running co-marketing or joint programs with technology or channel partners
    • Familiarity with agentic AI or enterprise automation markets
    • Experience managing G2 or similar review-platform programs (rating growth, review generation campaigns, badge/award cycles)

Sr. Partner Marketing Manager
About Skan AI
Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution
At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI
We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

Responsibilities
Strategy & Ownership
  • Define and own Skan AI’s overall partner marketing strategy across technology, consulting, and GSI partners — which partnerships to prioritize, how to sequence investment, and how partner marketing supports the broader company narrative
  • Serve as the senior connector between Skan AI’s partner organization and marketing leadership, with direct input into how partnerships are represented at the executive level
  • Set joint business plans with shared goals and mutual investment, and hold partners accountable for their commitments, co-investment, and sourced-pipeline targets through a regular joint business review cadence
  • Own the partner marketing budget and MDF/co-op programs: allocate funds across partners and tie that spend to clear ROI
Design & Execute Joint Go-to-Market
  • Design and execute go-to-market programs across our three partner categories — technology partners (e.g., NVIDIA), consulting partners, and GSI partners (e.g., Wipro) — focused on enterprise customer acquisition
  • Develop joint marketing campaigns targeting C-suite and senior decision-makers, built around real business outcomes, not just technology
  • Craft compelling joint value propositions that articulate what Skan AI plus a specific partner delivers that neither could alone
Build Enablement & Content

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you embed directly with our customers and take an agent from idea grounded in real work to running in production. You'll sit at the intersection of engineering, AI, and hands-on customer delivery: understanding a messy real-world process, capturing how it truly works, authoring the agent's operating logic, building and integrating it, and standing it up under strong governance and human oversight. This is a build-and-deploy role for engineers who like being close to the customer and the impact.
What you'll do
  • Embed with a customer team to understand a target workflow — including the exceptions and rework that never make it onto a slide.
  • Deploy our lightweight observation software and turn real, observed work into a clear specification for what the agent should do.
  • Author and validate the agent's operating procedure — its decision logic, rules, and escalation paths — and prove it against real cases before any build.
  • Build, integrate, and configure the agent, wiring it into enterprise systems with guardrails and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
  • Drive calibration, user acceptance testing, and shadow-mode validation through to a clean production go-live.
  • Instrument monitoring and quantify the business lift the agent delivers.
What we're looking for
  • 7+ years in software, data, or ML engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting.
  • Strong Python and SQL; hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform.
  • Experience building with LLMs / AI agents, or delivering data/ML products — in production or as serious prototypes.
  • Excellent communication and a genuine appetite for working directly with enterprise customers.
  • A pragmatic, outcome-driven mindset: you ground decisions in evidence and keep scope honest.
Bonus points
  • Process intelligence / process mining, RPA, or workflow-automation experience.
  • Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, insurance, healthcare).
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks, evaluation/observability tooling, Kubernetes, or VDI/mainframe environments.
Why Skan
  • Ship AI that does real work inside some of the world's largest enterprises — and see the impact directly.
  • Work across the whole stack of a deployment, not a narrow slice.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

About the Role
We are looking for a Sales Enablement Lead to own onboarding, training, and coaching for Skan's go-to-market team. This role owns everything a rep needs to be effective: product knowledge, how to execute the sales methodology, how to work with GSI, consulting, and advisory partners, and the coaching that closes skill gaps as they show up.
You will build a systematic view of where reps are struggling and why — drawing on win/loss reviews, call recordings, manager input, and direct conversations with the field — and turn what you learn into targeted enablement assets, training, and coaching plans. You own the full loop from diagnosis to delivered training to measured impact.
The ideal candidate has 5-7 years of experience in sales enablement, sales training, or a related field at a B2B SaaS company, has built and run a new-hire onboarding program from scratch, and is comfortable translating field feedback into rep-ready content.

Key Responsibilities

New Hire Onboarding
  • Own and continuously improve Skan's sales onboarding program, ensuring new reps ramp to productivity quickly and consistently.
  • Build structured onboarding curriculum covering product knowledge, ICP/personas, sales process, competitive positioning, and tools.
  • Own new-hire certification: define what “ramped” means and measure time-to-first-deal and time-to-quota.
Sales Methodology Enablement
  • Train reps on Skan's sales methodology and stage-by-stage process, ensuring consistent execution in the field.
  • Build and maintain battlecards, objection-handling guides, and deal-specific playbooks that reflect the current process.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product Management to translate product releases into rep-ready training and certification.
Voice of the Field & Coaching
  • Systematically capture what data alone can't show — win/loss themes, rep feedback, call recordings, and manager input — on where reps struggle and why.
  • Deliver ongoing coaching and skill-building programs for reps and frontline managers, including call reviews, deal reviews, and role-plays.
  • Close the loop with reps and managers on what changed as a result of their feedback.
Partner Motion Enablement
  • Train reps on how, when, and why to engage GSI, consulting, and advisory partners in deals.
  • Partner with the Partnerships team to build and deliver co-sell playbooks and partner engagement training.
  • Ensure reps understand deal registration, attribution, and co-sell processes across partner motions.
Performance Analysis & Enablement Design
  • Monitor rep and team performance trends — win rates, ramp time, deal outcomes — to identify where enablement should intervene.
  • Design and deliver targeted enablement assets and training plans that directly address the root causes behind underperformance.
  • Measure whether each enablement intervention actually moved the metric that triggered it, and iterate on what doesn't work.
Key Metrics for Success
  • Time-to-Productivity: Average ramp time for new reps to close their first deal and reach full quota capacity.
  • Onboarding Completion & Certification: Percentage of new hires certified on schedule.
  • Field Feedback Loop Closure: Percentage of significant field-reported issues that result in a tracked enablement change.
  • Insight-to-Action Velocity: Time from identifying a performance issue to shipping a targeted enablement response, and measurable improvement in the underlying metric.
  • Win Rate & Quota Attainment: Improvement in win rate and rep quota attainment tied to enablement initiatives.
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 5-7 years of experience in sales enablement, sales training, or field sales at a B2B SaaS company.
  • Proven track record building and running an onboarding program from scratch, including measurable improvements in ramp time.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise sales process and methodology (MEDDIC, Command of the Message, or similar).
  • Experience training reps on partner-sourced or partner-influenced motions (GSI, SI, or advisory) preferred.
  • Comfortable synthesizing performance data and direct field feedback into rep-ready training and coaching.
  • Excellent facilitation, coaching, and content-development skills; comfortable presenting to and coaching both new hires and tenured reps.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience a plus.


Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Directly shape how Skan's go-to-market team ramps, sells, and grows.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.
Compensation
The salary for this role is $130-160K OTE.

Benefits
  • 100% coverage of Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Work From Home
  • • Stock Option Plan

About the Role

As an Account Executive focused on new logo Healthcare accounts, you will own executive-level relationships with leading healthcare organizations, including integrated delivery networks (IDNs), health systems, academic medical centers, health insurers, digital health companies, and healthcare technology providers. You’ll help these organizations safely and effectively deploy Skan technology to improve clinical and administrative workflows, enhance patient and provider experiences, automate operational processes, and accelerate enterprise-wide AI adoption.

This role blends enterprise sales expertise, technical depth, business acumen, and relationship-driven selling. You will collaborate closely with administrators, researchers, engineers, and healthcare-focused solution strategists to design secure, compliant, and high-impact AI deployments.

You will carry a net revenue retention and expansion quota, with direct accountability for renewals, upsell, and new use-case development across your assigned book of business. You will partner with a cross-functional team — including delivery, value engineering, and solutions — to ensure customers realize measurable business outcomes from their investment in Skan, and you will serve as the primary voice of the customer internally.

Key Responsibilities
Account Strategy & Governance
  • Develop and execute multi-year account plans for each customer, aligning Skan's capabilities to the client's business objectives, transformation priorities, and operating model.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that connect Skan's impact to enterprise priorities and surface expansion opportunities across business units and geographies.
  • Maintain executive sponsor relationships at the COO, CIO, CFO, and Chief Transformation Officer level, ensuring Skan is embedded in the client's strategic agenda.

Customer Outcomes & Risk Management
  • Partner with the cross-functional account team — delivery, value engineering, solutions — to ensure consistent and measurable value delivery against customer success criteria.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate account risk: adoption gaps, stakeholder transitions, competitive pressure, or delivery concerns.
  • Maintain high customer satisfaction, strong platform adoption, and sustained engagement throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Escalate and resolve issues quickly, working cross-functionally to protect and strengthen the customer relationship.

Internal Advocacy & Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Represent customer needs internally, influencing product, marketing, and services priorities to strengthen Skan's BFSI enterprise offering.
  • Partner with the partnerships team to identify and activate GSI and SI co-delivery opportunities within your accounts.
Key Metrics for Success
  • Quota Attainment: Exceed $2.5M individual annual quota
  • Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) / New Business Revenue: Total new contract value generated from accounts. Net new ARR generated from upsell, cross-sell, and new use-case development within existing accounts.
  • Average Deal Size (ACV/ARR): Deal crafting in the range of $250-500-750K – $1-7M.
  • Pipeline Coverage Ratio: Maintain 3-5X active pipeline to ensure predictable future bookings.
  • Executive Engagement: Depth and frequency of C-suite relationships maintained per account.
  • QBR Cadence & Quality: Quarterly business reviews delivered on schedule with documented ROI evidence, diligent revenue reporting hygiene and forward-looking expansion plans.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account management or enterprise customer leadership at a B2B SaaS company or leading Agentic provider.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing large enterprise accounts with Fortune 500 BFSI clients — banks, insurers, asset managers, or diversified financial services firms.
  • Demonstrated success engaging and influencing C-suite executives (COO, CIO, CFO, Chief Transformation Officer) at global financial institutions, with experience navigating complex enterprise buying and governance environments.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience structuring, negotiating, and closing large enterprise agreements and managing accurate revenue forecasts.
  • Deep familiarity with BFSI operating environments and transformation priorities — claims, underwriting, loan operations, compliance, and back-office automation are areas you can speak to credibly.
  • Conversant in AI and data concepts; able to credibly engage technical stakeholders on models, data flows, and platform architecture at a working level.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.


About the Role

We are looking for a senior commercial leader to own a portfolio of strategic BFSI accounts — primarily large banks, insurers, and financial services firms. This is not a traditional account management role. You are the executive sponsor, the commercial owner, and the trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders simultaneously.

You will carry a net revenue retention and expansion quota, with direct accountability for renewals, upsell, and new use-case development across your assigned book of business. You will partner with a cross-functional team — including delivery, value engineering, and solutions — to ensure customers realize measurable business outcomes from their investment in Skan, and you will serve as the primary voice of the customer internally.

The ideal candidate has managed large enterprise accounts at a B2B SaaS company or a leading Agentic provider, has deep familiarity with BFSI operating environments, and can hold credible conversations with COOs, CIOs, and CFOs about AI, automation, and transformation strategy. This is not a relationship-manager role — this is a quota-carrying commercial role where you are accountable for outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Account Strategy & Governance
  • Develop and execute multi-year account plans for each customer, aligning Skan's capabilities to the client's business objectives, transformation priorities, and operating model.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that connect Skan's impact to enterprise priorities and surface expansion opportunities across business units and geographies.
  • Maintain executive sponsor relationships at the COO, CIO, CFO, and Chief Transformation Officer level, ensuring Skan is embedded in the client's strategic agenda.

Customer Outcomes & Risk Management
  • Partner with the cross-functional account team — delivery, value engineering, solutions — to ensure consistent and measurable value delivery against customer success criteria.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate account risk: adoption gaps, stakeholder transitions, competitive pressure, or delivery concerns.
  • Maintain high customer satisfaction, strong platform adoption, and sustained engagement throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Escalate and resolve issues quickly, working cross-functionally to protect and strengthen the customer relationship.

Internal Advocacy & Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Represent customer needs internally, influencing product, marketing, and services priorities to strengthen Skan's BFSI enterprise offering.
  • Partner with the partnerships team to identify and activate GSI and SI co-delivery opportunities within your accounts.
Key Metrics for Success
  • Quota Attainment: Exceed $2.5M individual annual quota
  • Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) / New Business Revenue: Total new contract value generated from accounts. Net new ARR generated from upsell, cross-sell, and new use-case development within existing accounts.
  • Average Deal Size (ACV/ARR): Deal crafting in the range of $250-500-750K – $1-7M.
  • Pipeline Coverage Ratio: Maintain 3-5X active pipeline to ensure predictable future bookings.
  • Executive Engagement: Depth and frequency of C-suite relationships maintained per account.
  • QBR Cadence & Quality: Quarterly business reviews delivered on schedule with documented ROI evidence, diligent revenue reporting hygiene and forward-looking expansion plans.
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account management or enterprise customer leadership at a B2B SaaS company or leading Agentic provider.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing large enterprise accounts with Fortune 500 BFSI clients — banks, insurers, asset managers, or diversified financial services firms.
  • Demonstrated success engaging and influencing C-suite executives (COO, CIO, CFO, Chief Transformation Officer) at global financial institutions, with experience navigating complex enterprise buying and governance environments.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience structuring, negotiating, and closing large enterprise agreements and managing accurate revenue forecasts.
  • Deep familiarity with BFSI operating environments and transformation priorities — claims, underwriting, loan operations, compliance, and back-office automation are areas you can speak to credibly.
  • Conversant in AI and data concepts; able to credibly engage technical stakeholders on models, data flows, and platform architecture at a working level.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience strongly preferred.
Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Own some of the most strategic BFSI enterprise relationships in the market, with a direct line to the C-suite at the world's largest financial institutions.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.

Compensation
The salary for this role is $325-375K OTE on a 60/40 split + uncapped commissions

Benefits
  • 100% coverage of Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Work From Home

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. We are shaping the future of work itself.


About the Role

We are looking for a senior commercial leader to own a portfolio of strategic BFSI accounts — primarily large banks, insurers, and financial services firms. This is not a traditional account management role. You are the executive sponsor, the commercial owner, and the trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders simultaneously.

You will carry a net revenue retention and expansion quota, with direct accountability for renewals, upsell, and new use-case development across your assigned book of business. You will partner with a cross-functional team — including delivery, value engineering, and solutions — to ensure customers realize measurable business outcomes from their investment in Skan, and you will serve as the primary voice of the customer internally.

The ideal candidate has managed large enterprise accounts at a B2B SaaS company or a leading Agentic provider, has deep familiarity with BFSI operating environments, and can hold credible conversations with COOs, CIOs, and CFOs about AI, automation, and transformation strategy. This is not a relationship-manager role — this is a quota-carrying commercial role where you are accountable for outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Account Strategy & Governance
  • Develop and execute multi-year account plans for each customer, aligning Skan's capabilities to the client's business objectives, transformation priorities, and operating model.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that connect Skan's impact to enterprise priorities and surface expansion opportunities across business units and geographies.
  • Maintain executive sponsor relationships at the COO, CIO, CFO, and Chief Transformation Officer level, ensuring Skan is embedded in the client's strategic agenda.

Renewal & Expansion
  • Own the commercial relationship end-to-end: forecast accuracy, contract negotiation, on-time renewals, and conversion of expansion opportunities.
  • Identify and develop upsell and cross-sell opportunities across new business units, geographies, and use cases — including claims automation, underwriting ops, compliance, and loan processing.
  • Carry a net revenue retention (NRR) and new ARR expansion quota across your assigned book of business.

Customer Outcomes & Risk Management
  • Partner with the cross-functional account team — delivery, value engineering, solutions — to ensure consistent and measurable value delivery against customer success criteria.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate account risk: adoption gaps, stakeholder transitions, competitive pressure, or delivery concerns.
  • Maintain high customer satisfaction, strong platform adoption, and sustained engagement throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Escalate and resolve issues quickly, working cross-functionally to protect and strengthen the customer relationship.

Internal Advocacy & Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Represent customer needs internally, influencing product, marketing, and services priorities to strengthen Skan's BFSI enterprise offering.
  • Partner with the partnerships team to identify and activate GSI and SI co-delivery opportunities within your accounts.
Key Metrics for Success
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR): Primary metric; target 150%+ NRR across assigned book of business.
  • Expansion ARR: Net new ARR generated from upsell, cross-sell, and new use-case development within existing accounts.
  • Executive Engagement: Depth and frequency of C-suite relationships maintained per account.
  • QBR Cadence & Quality: Quarterly business reviews delivered on schedule with documented ROI evidence and forward-looking expansion plans.
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account management or enterprise customer leadership at a B2B SaaS company or leading Agentic provider.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing large enterprise accounts with Fortune 500 BFSI clients — banks, insurers, asset managers, or diversified financial services firms.
  • Demonstrated success engaging and influencing C-suite executives (COO, CIO, CFO, Chief Transformation Officer) at global financial institutions, with experience navigating complex enterprise buying and governance environments.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience structuring, negotiating, and closing large enterprise agreements and managing accurate revenue forecasts.
  • Deep familiarity with BFSI operating environments and transformation priorities — claims, underwriting, loan operations, compliance, and back-office automation are areas you can speak to credibly.
  • Conversant in AI and data concepts; able to credibly engage technical stakeholders on models, data flows, and platform architecture at a working level.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience strongly preferred.
Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Own some of the most strategic BFSI enterprise relationships in the market, with a direct line to the C-suite at the world's largest financial institutions.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.

Compensation
The salary for this role is $325-375K OTE on a 60/40 split + uncapped commissions

Benefits
  • 100% coverage of Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)

  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Work From Home

  • Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) / New Business Revenue: Total new contract value generated from accounts. Net new ARR generated from upsell, cross-sell, and new use-case development within existing accounts.

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account management or enterprise customer leadership at a B2B SaaS company or leading Agentic provider.

  • Deep familiarity with BFSI operating environments and transformation priorities — claims, underwriting, loan operations, compliance, and back-office automation are areas you can speak to credibly.
  • Conversant in AI and data concepts; able to credibly engage technical stakeholders on models, data flows, and platform architecture at a working level.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience strongly preferred.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.


About the Role

As an Account Executive focused on new logo strategic BFSI accounts — primarily large banks, insurers, and financial services firms. You’ll help these organizations safely and effectively deploy Skan technology to improve clinical and administrative workflows, enhance patient and provider experiences, automate operational processes, and accelerate enterprise-wide AI adoption.

This role blends enterprise sales expertise, technical depth, business acumen, and relationship-driven selling. You will collaborate closely with administrators, researchers, engineers, and healthcare-focused solution strategists to design secure, compliant, and high-impact AI deployments.

The ideal candidate has managed large enterprise accounts at a B2B SaaS company or a leading Agentic provider, has deep familiarity with BFSI operating environments, and can hold credible conversations with COOs, CIOs, and CFOs about AI, automation, and transformation strategy. This is not a relationship-manager role — this is a quota-carrying commercial role where you are accountable for outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Account Strategy & Governance
  • Develop and execute multi-year account plans for each customer, aligning Skan's capabilities to the client's business objectives, transformation priorities, and operating model.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that connect Skan's impact to enterprise priorities and surface expansion opportunities across business units and geographies.
  • Maintain executive sponsor relationships at the COO, CIO, CFO, and Chief Transformation Officer level, ensuring Skan is embedded in the client's strategic agenda.

Renewal & Expansion
  • Own the commercial relationship end-to-end: forecast accuracy, contract negotiation, on-time renewals, and conversion of expansion opportunities.
  • Identify and develop upsell and cross-sell opportunities across new business units, geographies, and use cases — including claims automation, underwriting ops, compliance, and loan processing.
  • Carry a net revenue retention (NRR) and new ARR expansion quota across your assigned book of business.

Customer Outcomes & Risk Management
  • Partner with the cross-functional account team — delivery, value engineering, solutions — to ensure consistent and measurable value delivery against customer success criteria.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate account risk: adoption gaps, stakeholder transitions, competitive pressure, or delivery concerns.
  • Maintain high customer satisfaction, strong platform adoption, and sustained engagement throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Escalate and resolve issues quickly, working cross-functionally to protect and strengthen the customer relationship.

Internal Advocacy & Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Represent customer needs internally, influencing product, marketing, and services priorities to strengthen Skan's BFSI enterprise offering.
  • Partner with the partnerships team to identify and activate GSI and SI co-delivery opportunities within your accounts.
Key Metrics for Success

  • Quota Attainment: Exceed $2.5M individual annual quota
  • Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) / New Business Revenue: Total new contract value generated from accounts. Net new ARR generated from upsell, cross-sell, and new use-case development within existing accounts.
  • Average Deal Size (ACV/ARR): Deal crafting in the range of $250-500-750K – $1-7M.
  • Pipeline Coverage Ratio: Maintain 3-5X active pipeline to ensure predictable future bookings.
  • Executive Engagement: Depth and frequency of C-suite relationships maintained per account.
  • QBR Cadence & Quality: Quarterly business reviews delivered on schedule with documented ROI evidence, diligent revenue reporting hygiene and forward-looking expansion plans.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account management or enterprise customer leadership at a B2B SaaS company or leading Agentic provider.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing large enterprise accounts with Fortune 500 BFSI clients — banks, insurers, asset managers, or diversified financial services firms.
  • Demonstrated success engaging and influencing C-suite executives (COO, CIO, CFO, Chief Transformation Officer) at global financial institutions, with experience navigating complex enterprise buying and governance environments.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience structuring, negotiating, and closing large enterprise agreements and managing accurate revenue forecasts.
  • Deep familiarity with BFSI operating environments and transformation priorities — claims, underwriting, loan operations, compliance, and back-office automation are areas you can speak to credibly.
  • Conversant in AI and data concepts; able to credibly engage technical stakeholders on models, data flows, and platform architecture at a working level.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience strongly preferred.
Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Own some of the most strategic BFSI enterprise relationships in the market, with a direct line to the C-suite at the world's largest financial institutions.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Role Description
Reporting to the Head of Growth Marketing, this pivotal role focuses on enabling growth and driving operational efficiency across Marketing and Sales through automation, data-driven processes, and scalable campaign execution.

As the Marketing Operations Manager, you’ll work closely with Marketing and Sales leadership to build and optimize a high-performing revenue engine. You'll own the Marketing tech stack, and provide the technical administration, integrations, and automation that power the Sales tech stack in partnership with Sales Operations, so both teams run on one connected system. You’ll also lead analytics and reporting, building the infrastructure to track KPIs, inform decision-making, and align cross-functional stakeholders. This role is ideal for a self-starter who thrives in the details and knows how to connect data, process, and strategy to accelerate growth.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the systems, processes, and automation that power scalable, efficient, and aligned Marketing and Sales execution across the entire revenue engine.
  • Administer and architect HubSpot CRM (object model, properties, lifecycle stages, workflows, permissions, and integrations) as the shared system of record for Marketing and Sales.
  • Serve as the technical systems partner to the Sales Operations team: build and maintain the CRM automations, integrations, and data pipelines that let Sales Ops scale without adding manual overhead.
  • Provide the data infrastructure that supports Sales Operations' forecasting, territory, and capacity planning.
  • Run and continuously improve a modern Marketing & Sales tech stack to ensure seamless integration and scalability across CRM, marketing automation, website, attribution, and enrichment tools.
  • Partner with Marketing and Sales leadership to align on GTM strategy, pipeline goals, and operational priorities.
  • Support strategic planning by contributing to annual revenue modeling across marketing channels and BDR capacity, in alignment with sales operations.
  • Lead automation initiatives across inbound and outbound channels, including lead scoring, routing, segmentation, and nurture workflows to drive efficiency and scale.
  • Implement workflows with SLA tracking and reporting to ensure timely lead follow-up and accountability across the funnel.
  • Enable BDRs with automated, high-quality lead lists to support targeted and efficient outbound execution.
  • Operationalize ABM strategy by analyzing account engagement and penetration to uncover expansion opportunities and fuel upsell revenue.
  • Build a deal analytics framework to provide visibility on sales velocity, funnel conversion performance, and pipeline health.
  • Build and maintain reporting infrastructure to track key Marketing and Sales metrics, funnel health, attribution, and ROI.
  • Ensure data integrity, governance, and hygiene across systems to deliver accurate, reliable reporting.
  • Document workflows, processes, and automation logic to drive consistency and operational scalability.
  • Evaluate and implement new tools as needed to support growth while maintaining operational stability and business impact.

Qualifications & Skills
  • 6-8 years of experience in marketing operations within fast-growing B2B SaaS/Tech companies.
  • Deep expertise in HubSpot (CRM, Marketing Hub, automation, reporting, website management, lifecycle workflows, and database hygiene).
  • Expert in building and managing full-funnel Marketing and Sales reporting infrastructure.
  • Proven ability to support Fortune 500 ABM programs and analyze funnel velocity to uncover bottlenecks and improve conversion rates.
  • Experienced with multi-touch attribution models to evaluate channel performance and optimize marketing investments.
  • Skilled in managing and optimizing a modern Marketing RevOps tech stack: HubSpot, Claude Code, ZoomInfo, Clay (enrichment), Nooks (dialers), Zime (Insights), and integration platforms such as N8N, or Zapier.
  • Hands-on experience working with AI coding tools such as Claude Code to build, automate, and accelerate Marketing Operations workflows.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts and budgets.
  • Proficient in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and UTM tracking.
  • Solid understanding of email deliverability, domain/IP management, and warm-up best practices.
  • Collaborative partner to Sales, BDR, Marketing, and Leadership teams aligning strategy with flawless execution.
  • Strong analytical skills with a data-driven mindset. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to shift seamlessly between strategic planning and hands-on execution.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

AI Solutions is our global post-sales and professional-services organization — the team that takes process intelligence and agentic AI out of pilots and into production, and owns customer outcomes end-to-end. We are AI-first by default: we spot repeating patterns and build agents to automate them, scaling the value we deliver with the book of business, not with headcount.

The role.  The design authority and quality bar for the team — a functional-governance role for the most technical, most trusted consultant in the room. You set the solution-quality bar across the whole team, frame and gate-review the hardest solutions before they ship, build the industry-specific playbooks and reusable AI assets that scale everyone, and lead from the front, hands-on, on the toughest work. Additionally, you own your own book of accounts end-to-end — these are the highest-impact, most strategic accounts the company has. You begin to own top-line and margin alongside delivery leadership. For a seasoned leader from a top consulting firm or SI who wants to build, ship and set the standard, this is the seat.

What you own
  • Full end-to-end ownership of your own book — the highest-impact, most strategic accounts the company has (across industries such as BFSI and healthcare), owned from discovery to realized value.
  • Design authority and the solution-quality bar across the team — you frame the hardest problems and gate-review solutions before they ship.
  • Industry-specific playbooks and reusable AI assets that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
  • Leading from the front — hands-on where the solution stretches beyond out-of-the-box — and coaching the Seniors.
  • Top-line and margin awareness — beginning to own the delivery-leadership economics alongside delivery leadership.
What we look for
  • 8+ years with deep, demonstrable end-to-end delivery leadership on strategic accounts; top consulting-firm / SI leaders who now build and ship, not just advise.
  • Principal-level technical depth and architecture judgment — sets standards, builds playbooks, raises the bar for others.
  • Industry depth (BFSI, healthcare or similar) and the ability to build reusable, industry-specific assets.
  • Commercial awareness — comfortable reasoning about utilization, top-line and margin.
  • Solutions-led leader who leads by example; heavily hands-on at the highest bar.
The persona & bar
  • Thrives in uncertainty: Can run a substantive, back-and-forth customer conversation, build on a fuzzy idea, and convert uncertainty into certainty — Idea → Implementation → Impact. Customers are under pressure and want someone who guides and coaches them.
  • Pragmatic solutioning: Navigates roadblocks and imperfect systems without waiting to be told what to do — independent judgment over guidance-dependence.
  • Data-first, value-driven (not task execution): The real work isn't just executing the task in front of you. You own the step before — figuring out what data matters to create foresight on what to optimize — and the step after — the 'what next' that turns insight into value — keeping everything aligned to the customer's bigger goals.
  • AI-first by default: Collects data first, then builds agents to optimize workflows — moving past large, manual analyst-and-developer teams.
  • Ownership, agility, client-facing: Continuous contact with the customer and heavy ownership across every one of these dimensions.
How the role works
  • Our priorities, in order: product expert (trained and certified on Skan), AI-first (agents do the repeat work — every consultant a 10x consultant), solutions-led (solve the true business problem), and end-to-end ownership from discovery through adoption.
  • The bar: you solve real customer problems, and you independently lead a customer discovery session — turning discovery and ideas into a clear plan to ship and adopt an AI solution.
  • Hands-on and technical: you set the solution bar, gate-review the toughest work, and still build from the front where it counts.
  • Travel and focus: roughly 40% travel to customer sites; about 60% on delivery, 20% coaching the team, 20% learning.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

ROLE SUMMARY
The Systems Engineer is the technical backbone for Skan's self-hosted or customer-hosted (on-prem and hybrid) deployments. This role owns the end-to-end coordination, deployment, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Skan's software within enterprise customer environments. Working directly with customer IT teams and alongside Skan's DevOps and onboarding engineers, the Systems Engineer ensures that customer-hosted deployments are stable, performant, and well-supported.

This role combines strategic architecture design with hands-on troubleshooting — validating customer infrastructure readiness, ensuring seamless end-to-end connectivity, and guaranteeing the successful operationalization of Skan components throughout the customer lifecycle.

The Systems Engineer specializes in the complexity of enterprise on-prem infrastructure: Windows and Linux server environments, enterprise networking, virtualization, and the integration challenges unique to air-gapped or security-restricted customer environments.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
A significant portion of Skan's enterprise customers — particularly in regulated industries — run Skan in customer-hosted environments where Skan has no direct infrastructure control. These deployments require a dedicated engineering resource who can work within customer constraints, troubleshoot in complex enterprise environments, and bridge the technical gap between Skan's platform and the customer's IT team.

Without dedicated Systems Engineers, customer-hosted deployments are under-supported, incidents escalate slowly, and deployment quality is inconsistent — creating delivery risk and churn exposure for Skan's highest-value accounts.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Deployment & Environment Management
  • Lead the coordination of new customer Skan Virtual Assistant & Gateway deployments from initial planning through to completion — validating infrastructure readiness and ensuring all technical prerequisites are met prior to go-live
  • Perform new customer environment builds in partnership with the onboarding team — ensuring environments are correctly sized, configured, and validated
  • Execute patch cycles, upgrades, and maintenance releases for all customer-hosted Skan deployments — on schedule with zero unplanned downtime
  • Manage and execute the technical aspects of upgrading existing customer environments

Architecture & Infrastructure
  • Design and implement Skan architecture solutions aligned with business and technical requirements
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure monitoring dashboards and alerting systems
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and platform issues in customer environments — including network, server, OS, and integration layer problems
  • Perform root cause analysis for infrastructure incidents and implement preventive measures
  • Support the team during HA/DR validation activities for customer-hosted deployment models
  • Manage system maintenance, upgrades, and disaster recovery plans

Customer Engagement
  • Act as the primary technical partner throughout the entire customer lifecycle — providing transparent, business-friendly communication on system health, infrastructure changes, and technical risks
  • Work directly with customer IT teams during deployment, maintenance, and incident response — serving as Skan's technical representative in joint sessions
  • Negotiate technical requirements with customers and stakeholders
  • Address and resolve technical concerns across all touchpoints: pre-sales discovery, onboarding, post-deployment optimization, and regular health reviews
  • Participate in on-call rotation for customer-hosted environment incidents

Documentation & Process
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation: architecture diagrams, configuration baselines, runbooks, disaster recovery plans, and change logs — per customer
  • Coordinate with the DevOps team to apply CI/CD practices and automation tooling to customer-hosted deployment activities where feasible
  • Contribute to SLA tracking by ensuring environment health metrics are captured and escalated appropriately
  • Identify recurring deployment and configuration issues and propose systemic fixes — escalating pattern-level problems to DevOps or Architecture teams
  • Create standardized communication templates for customer interactions and executive-level infrastructure summaries for stakeholders
KEY DELIVERABLES
  • Successful deployment of Skan platform in new customer-hosted environments — validated, documented, and handed off within agreed timelines
  • Patch and upgrade records for all customer-hosted environments — executed on schedule with zero unplanned downtime
  • Environment documentation per customer: architecture diagrams, configuration baselines, and change logs — maintained and current
  • Incident response records for customer-hosted environment issues — with root cause and resolution documented
  • Customer IT team satisfaction: professional, clear, and responsive technical engagement during joint sessions
  • Customer-hosted environment uptime ≥ 99% across all managed accounts

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) owns the reliability, availability, and operational health of Skan's cloud-hosted customer environments. Sitting within the Customer Cloud Ops team, this role bridges software and infrastructure — applying engineering discipline to automate toil, respond to incidents rapidly, and uphold the SLA commitments that protect Skan's enterprise relationships.
The SRE is accountable for keeping production customer environments running at the performance and availability standards enterprise clients expect. This means being on-call, being proactive about operational risk, and continuously eliminating the manual work that gets in the way of reliable operations.
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
As Skan's cloud-hosted customer base grows, the complexity and volume of environment management, incident response, and reliability engineering grows with it. Without dedicated SRE capability, operational toil accumulates, incidents take longer to resolve, and SLA commitments are at risk — damaging customer trust and creating costly escalations.
The SRE function applies software engineering practices to infrastructure and operations — replacing manual, reactive processes with automation, runbooks, and agentic workflows that scale.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Monitor platform health and performance across all cloud-hosted customer environments using observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent)
  • Respond to and own P1/P2 incidents — lead triage, diagnosis, and resolution; drive MTTR reduction through structured post-incident review
  • Perform ongoing capacity and environment planning for customer cloud deployments — anticipating growth and preventing resource-related incidents
  • Design and implement SRE automation to eliminate repetitive operational toil — agentic alerting, auto-remediation scripts, and automated runbook execution
  • Manage change and release events that affect production customer environments — coordinating with DevOps and product teams to minimize risk
  • Maintain and improve runbooks for all known failure patterns and operational procedures
  • Contribute to HA/DR playbook validation
  • Participate in on-call rotation and respond to alerts within defined SLA windows
  • Track and report on SLO/SLA adherence — contributing to monthly operational reports and QBR data
  • Identify and escalate environment risks proactively — before they become customer-facing incidents
  • Collaborate with the Automation Engineering team to develop agentic workflows that automate triage, routing, and remediation
KEY DELIVERABLES
  • Incident response records and post-mortems for all P1/P2 events — with root cause, remediation steps, and prevention actions documented
  • SLA/SLO dashboards: availability and performance reports for all cloud customer environments — updated continuously
  • Capacity and environment sizing plans per customer — reviewed quarterly or on significant usage change
  • Automated toil-reduction scripts and agentic remediation workflows — measurable reduction in manual operational hours
  • Runbooks for all known failure patterns — maintained and validated against real incidents
  • Change management records for all production environment events
  • Target: ≥ 99.9% uptime across all cloud-hosted customer environments
KEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS
  • 5-8 years of experience as a SRE engineer
  • Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP — environment management, networking, IAM, and observability at scale
  • Observability and monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent — building dashboards, alerts, and SLO tracking
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi — provisioning and configuration management
  • Incident management: on-call discipline, structured MTTR mindset, post-mortem culture, and blameless review practices
  • Scripting and automation: Python, Bash — automation of operational tasks and agentic workflow development
  • Linux systems administration: process management, log analysis, performance tuning
  • Container orchestration: Kubernetes and Docker — deployment management and debugging in production
  • SRE fundamentals: SLI/SLO/SLA definition, error budget management, toil measurement and reduction
  • Strong written documentation skills — clear, evidence-based runbooks and incident reports

Job Title: Lead, AI-Enabled Data Analyst
Skan.ai is a leading process intelligence software company building the fabric of the future of work. We're hiring a hands-on Lead Data Analyst to own our analytics function end-to-end — building dashboards personally, mining data for insight, and making sure the reporting platforms behind them scale and stay reliable at production volume.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analytics Delivery: Personally architect and build Power BI and Superset dashboards, delivering descriptive and prescriptive analytics tied to measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep-Dive Analysis & AI-Augmented Insight: Run deep-dive analyses to surface patterns and trends. Use Skan.ai's built-in AI/LLM and NLP capabilities to accelerate analysis of unstructured process and customer data — this is about applying AI tooling to get to insight faster, not building or maintaining models. Partner with the data science team when a question needs model-level depth.
  • Data Observability: Monitor the health of reporting data pipelines — schema drift, freshness, volume anomalies, and quality checks across Superset/Power BI sources — and escalate before issues reach a customer dashboard.
  • Database & Reporting Platform Ownership: Configure, tune, and scale the SQL/Superset/Power BI stack for very large data volumes. Set up monitoring and performance metrics, and recommend environment sizing.
  • Production Support & Capacity Planning: Troubleshoot production data and database issues, plan for capacity upgrades, perform maintenance, monitor performance, and take proactive action to prevent outages.
  • Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with customers on tailored analytics solutions, and with AI Solutions Consultants, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to shape the platform roadmap.
  • Team Leadership: Build and mentor a high-performing analytics team grounded in ownership and accountability.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience: 10+ years of hands-on leadership in business intelligence, advanced analytics, or data science, with a track record of personally delivering data-driven solutions.
  • Core Technical Depth — SQL, Databases, and Visualization: Deep, hands-on expertise in SQL, database, and data visualization (Power BI, Superset). Must be technically strong across all three areas, not specialized in just one.
  • Scale & Database Administration: Proven experience scaling and supporting reports against very large data volumes. Hands-on with Reports configuration; SQL tuning, monitoring setup, and environment sizing recommendations.
  • AI, LLM & NLP Fluency: Comfortable using LLM- and NLP-based tools (extraction, classification, summarization) to speed up data analysis. This is a using-AI-as-a-tool requirement, not a model-building one — deep ML/data science expertise is not expected.
  • Data Observability: Experience setting up or working with data observability practices — monitoring for schema drift, data freshness, volume/quality anomalies — across BI and warehouse layers.
  • Platform Breadth: Additional experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or Tableau is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Highly collaborative and low-ego — equally comfortable pairing with engineers on SQL/DB tuning and walking a customer through a dashboard. Clear communicator who can translate technical tradeoffs (sizing, performance, risk) into plain language for non-technical stakeholders. Genuinely curious and eager to learn and grow, with the resilience and ownership mindset to run toward ambiguous production issues rather than waiting to be told what to do.
  • Bonus: Experience in process mining, automation intelligence, or value engineering is highly desirable.
