Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist who loves to get their hands dirty. This is a deeply hands-on role; you will build and own ML models and data pipelines, work directly with large and messy real-world datasets, and be the go-to person when something breaks or doesn't make sense. You will also play a key guiding role for junior data scientists and analysts on the team, helping them grow through close collaboration, code reviews, and day-to-day technical direction.
You are not a manager, but you are a multiplier. The best candidate is someone who writes excellent code in the morning, helps a junior teammate unblock an issue in the afternoon, and debugs a tricky customer data problem before EOD, and finds all three equally satisfying.

What You'll Do
Hands-On Modelling & Algorithm Development
  • Build, train, evaluate, and improve ML models that power core Skan.ai features including but not limited to task detection, behavioral pattern recognition, process mapping, and drift analysis.
  • Own the full modelling lifecycle: data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning and validation.
  • Run disciplined experiments: define clear hypotheses, design evaluation frameworks, and present findings with statistical rigour.
  • Write clean, well-tested, production-ready Python code that your teammates can maintain and build on.
Data Pipelines & Large-Scale Data
  • Design and build reliable data pipelines that handle high volumes of multimodal enterprise data such as screen telemetry, event logs, and structured process data.
  • Work hands-on with distributed data platforms (Spark, Databricks, or equivalent) to process, transform, and validate data at scale.
  • Own data quality at every step: define validation checks, detect drift, monitor pipeline health, and fix issues proactively.
  • Collaborate with engineering to optimise ingestion and feature generation workflows for speed, cost, and reliability.
Customer Issue Diagnosis & Production Support
  • Investigate and resolve data and model issues that surface in customer environments; trace root causes across pipelines, features, and model behaviour.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Solutions teams to understand unexpected outcomes and translate them into concrete technical fixes.
  • Build internal diagnostic tooling and dashboards that make it easier to spot and triage data anomalies and model degradation in production.
  • Document findings clearly so that patterns are captured and future issues are resolved faster.
Guiding & Mentoring Junior Team Members
  • Serve as the day-to-day technical guide for junior data scientists and analysts; answer questions, review code, pair on hard problems, and help them grow.
  • Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews that improve both the work and the person who wrote it.
  • Help junior teammates develop good habits: experiment tracking, reproducibility, clean data handling, and robust validation.
  • Run informal knowledge-sharing sessions: walkthroughs of new techniques, post-mortems on what went wrong, or deep-dives into a dataset.
  • Flag blockers and skill gaps to the Principal/Chief Scientist and help shape how the team grows technically over time.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with product and engineering to understand requirements, scope data work, and deliver on time.
  • Communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders; translate model outputs and data insights into plain language that drives decisions.
  • Contribute technical input to sprint planning and quarterly priorities; flag feasibility concerns early and propose alternatives.

What We're Looking For
Required
  • M.S. or B.S./B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 5–8 years of industry experience building and shipping data science or ML solutions in production.
  • Strong Python skills with clean, modular, testable code as a baseline expectation.
  • Solid experience with large-scale data processing using Spark, Databricks, or similar distributed frameworks.
  • Proficiency in at least two of: supervised/unsupervised ML, NLP, deep learning, sequence modelling, or process mining.
  • Experience diagnosing and fixing real-world data quality and model behaviour issues in production systems.
  • A genuine interest in helping junior colleagues grow; this should excite you, not feel like a tax on your time.
  • Clear, concise communication: you can explain a complex model or a data issue to an engineer, a PM, or a customer success manager without jargon.
Nice to Have
  • Exposure to process mining, RPA, workflow analytics, or enterprise operations intelligence.
  • Experience with MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar experiment tracking and model management tools.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, transformer-based models, or multimodal learning pipelines.
  • Prior experience in a product-focused startup or scale-up environment.

Why Skan.ai
  • Not a support role: Real ownership from day one
  • You will own models and pipelines end-to-end; not hand off tickets to a team in another timezone.
  • Interesting work: Hard, novel problems
  • You will work on problems that don't have off-the-shelf solutions.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate.
We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

About the Role
We are looking for a Revenue Operations Lead to own the data, pipeline intelligence, and process foundation behind Skan's go-to-market engine — and to turn what that foundation reveals into automation that measurably improves how the revenue engine runs. This role owns the full loop: the data itself, the pipeline intelligence and forecast drawn from it, the sales process it should be measured against, the territory structure that plans against it, and the agentic workflows built to reinforce it.

Concretely: you own CRM data quality because clean data is what makes pipeline intelligence trustworthy. You own pipeline intelligence and forecasting because together they tell you where deals stall, where reps struggle, and what the business should expect to close. You own the sales process definition because intelligence is only useful measured against a defined standard. You own territory design because that's how coverage gets planned against the pipeline. And you own turning all of that into automation — identifying which manual or inconsistent steps in the revenue process are worth solving with an agentic workflow, building it, and measuring whether it worked.

The ideal candidate has 5-7 years of experience in revenue or sales operations at a B2B SaaS company, is hands-on with CRM administration, pipeline analysis, and forecasting, and is comfortable both defining process and building the automated workflows that reinforce it.

Key Responsibilities

Data & CRM Hygiene
  • Own CRM data quality (Salesforce or equivalent) — field completeness, validation rules, and pipeline stage discipline — as the foundation everything else depends on.
  • Run ongoing data hygiene audits and remediation, and define the standards reps are held to.
  • Partner with Sales and Systems/IT to prioritize CRM and tooling improvements that improve data reliability.
Pipeline Intelligence & Forecasting
  • Analyze pipeline data to surface where deals stall, where reps consistently struggle, and where deal patterns diverge from the defined process.
  • Own the forecasting process and cadence — methodology, inputs, roll-up, and accuracy — in partnership with Sales leadership.
  • Translate pipeline and forecast patterns into specific recommendations: where an agentic workflow should be built or improved, and where enablement should intervene.
  • Maintain a standing view of pipeline health that Sales, Enablement, and Systems can all work from.
Sales Process Definition & Governance
  • Own and continuously refine the definition of Skan's stage-by-stage sales process, including qualification, discovery, demo, proof-of-value, and closing.
  • Ensure the process is the standard that pipeline intelligence is measured against and that agentic workflows are built to reinforce.
  • Govern process changes as the business evolves — new products, new personas, new competitive landscape — and keep the CRM configuration aligned to them.
Agentic Workflow Design & Build
  • Build and maintain agentic workflows that automate and monitor the revenue process, prioritized by what data and pipeline intelligence surface as highest-impact.
  • Identify manual, error-prone, or inconsistent steps in the revenue process and replace them with automated, agent-driven workflows.
  • Measure whether each agentic workflow actually moved the metric that triggered it, and retire or iterate on what doesn't work.
Territory Planning
  • Design and maintain territory and account assignment structures that align coverage with market opportunity.
  • Run capacity and coverage modeling to inform headcount planning and territory rebalancing as the business grows.

Key Metrics for Success
  • CRM Data Quality: Field completeness, pipeline stage accuracy, and data hygiene audit scores.
  • Pipeline Intelligence Coverage: Percentage of major stall points and rep struggle areas identified and diagnosed each quarter.
  • Forecast Accuracy: Variance between forecasted and closed results across the sales cycle.
  • Process Currency: How up to date the defined sales process and CRM configuration are relative to how the business actually sells.
  • Territory Coverage & Balance: Even distribution of opportunity and capacity across territories relative to market potential.
  • Agentic Workflow Adoption & Impact: Adoption rate of automated workflows and measurable time/cycle savings in the revenue process.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 5-7 years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or a related function at a B2B SaaS company.
  • Hands-on experience administering a CRM (Salesforce or equivalent) and analyzing pipeline data to surface actionable patterns.
  • Experience owning or managing a forecasting process, including methodology, cadence, and accuracy.
  • Experience owning or shaping a sales methodology and stage-by-stage process (MEDDIC, Command of the Message, or similar).
  • Experience with territory design and capacity/coverage modeling.
  • Experience building or deploying automated/agentic workflows within a revenue organization strongly preferred.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience a plus.

Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Directly shape how Skan's revenue engine runs, from data quality to automation.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.

Benefits
  • 100% coverage of Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Work From Home
  • Stock Option Plan

Salary Range: $130K - $165K OTE

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate.

We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

AI Solutions is our global post-sales and professional-services organization — the team that takes process intelligence and agentic AI out of pilots and into production, and owns customer outcomes end-to-end. We are AI-first by default: we spot repeating patterns and build agents to automate them, scaling the value we deliver with the book of business, not with headcount.

The role.  The design authority and quality bar for the team — a functional-governance role for the most technical, most trusted consultant in the room. You set the solution-quality bar across the whole team, frame and gate-review the hardest solutions before they ship, build the industry-specific playbooks and reusable AI assets that scale everyone, and lead from the front, hands-on, on the toughest work. Additionally, you own your own book of accounts end-to-end — these are the highest-impact, most strategic accounts the company has. You begin to own top-line and margin alongside delivery leadership. For a seasoned leader from a top consulting firm or SI who wants to build, ship and set the standard, this is the seat.

What you own
  • Full end-to-end ownership of your own book — the highest-impact, most strategic accounts the company has (across industries such as BFSI and healthcare), owned from discovery to realized value.
  • Design authority and the solution-quality bar across the team — you frame the hardest problems and gate-review solutions before they ship.
  • Industry-specific playbooks and reusable AI assets that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
  • Leading from the front — hands-on where the solution stretches beyond out-of-the-box — and coaching the Seniors.
  • Top-line and margin awareness — beginning to own the delivery-leadership economics alongside delivery leadership.
What we look for
  • 8+ years with deep, demonstrable end-to-end delivery leadership on strategic accounts; top consulting-firm / SI leaders who now build and ship, not just advise.
  • Principal-level technical depth and architecture judgment — sets standards, builds playbooks, raises the bar for others.
  • Industry depth (BFSI, healthcare or similar) and the ability to build reusable, industry-specific assets.
  • Commercial awareness — comfortable reasoning about utilization, top-line and margin.
  • Solutions-led leader who leads by example; heavily hands-on at the highest bar.
The persona & bar
  • Thrives in uncertainty: Can run a substantive, back-and-forth customer conversation, build on a fuzzy idea, and convert uncertainty into certainty — Idea → Implementation → Impact. Customers are under pressure and want someone who guides and coaches them.
  • Pragmatic solutioning: Navigates roadblocks and imperfect systems without waiting to be told what to do — independent judgment over guidance-dependence.
  • Data-first, value-driven (not task execution): The real work isn't just executing the task in front of you. You own the step before — figuring out what data matters to create foresight on what to optimize — and the step after — the 'what next' that turns insight into value — keeping everything aligned to the customer's bigger goals.
  • AI-first by default: Collects data first, then builds agents to optimize workflows — moving past large, manual analyst-and-developer teams.
  • Ownership, agility, client-facing: Continuous contact with the customer and heavy ownership across every one of these dimensions.
How the role works
  • Our priorities, in order: product expert (trained and certified on Skan), AI-first (agents do the repeat work — every consultant a 10x consultant), solutions-led (solve the true business problem), and end-to-end ownership from discovery through adoption.
  • The bar: you solve real customer problems, and you independently lead a customer discovery session — turning discovery and ideas into a clear plan to ship and adopt an AI solution.
  • Hands-on and technical: you set the solution bar, gate-review the toughest work, and still build from the front where it counts.
  • Travel and focus: roughly 40% travel to customer sites; about 60% on delivery, 20% coaching the team, 20% learning.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution
At Skan AI, you'll be part of the team pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.
Why Join Skan AI
We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Database Administrator (DBA) with deep, hands-on expertise across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Databricks to own the health, performance, scalability, and reliability of our large-scale data environments. This is a highly technical role for someone who thrives on operating databases at very high data volumes and who takes pride in building systems that are fast, resilient, and cost-efficient.
The primary focus of this role is administration and platform engineering: configuring, setting up, and continuously optimizing database platforms; instrumenting comprehensive monitoring and metrics; right-sizing environments in response to changing demand; and standing up schemas and configurations aligned to evolving requirements. As a secondary but important focus, the role supports data analysis activities, troubleshoots production data issues, plans capacity, performs maintenance, and takes proactive action to prevent outages before they occur.
The ideal candidate is technically outstanding across all three platforms, highly collaborative, and genuinely eager to learn and grow as our data estate and technology stack evolve.

Primary Responsibilities — Database Administration & Platform Engineering

Configuration, Setup & Optimization

  • Provision and configure PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Databricks environments from the ground up, applying tuned parameters, storage layouts, and connection strategies appropriate to very large data volumes.
  • Optimize database configuration on an ongoing basis — memory, buffers, connection pooling, indexing strategy, partitioning/sharding, vacuum/compaction, query planning, and workload isolation — to sustain performance as volumes grow.
  • Stand up schemas and configurations based on functional and non-functional requirements gathered from engineering, analytics, and product stakeholders, balancing normalization, access patterns, and performance.
  • Manage Databricks clusters, workspaces, and compute policies, tuning Spark configurations, autoscaling behavior, and storage (Delta Lake) layouts for efficient processing of very large datasets.

Monitoring, Metrics & Observability

  • Design and implement monitoring across all three platforms — throughput, latency, query performance, replication lag, lock contention, storage utilization, and resource saturation.
  • Establish meaningful metrics, dashboards, and alerting thresholds that surface issues early and drive proactive intervention rather than reactive firefighting.
  • Define and track service-level objectives (SLOs) and key operational indicators, and report on the health and performance of the data estate.

Elastic Scaling & Capacity Management

  • Resize and scale environments — vertically and horizontally — based on real-time and forecasted demand, ensuring performance during peaks while controlling cost during troughs.
  • Implement and tune autoscaling, sharding, replication, and partitioning strategies to accommodate sustained growth in data volume and concurrency.
  • Continuously evaluate cost-to-performance trade-offs across cloud storage and compute tiers.

Secondary Responsibilities — Operations, Reliability & Analysis Support

Production Troubleshooting & Proactive Reliability

  • Troubleshoot and resolve production data issues, including slow queries, data anomalies, replication problems, contention, and platform incidents — often under time pressure.
  • Monitor for performance degradation and take proactive action to prevent outages before they impact users, based on data-driven signals and early warning indicators.
  • Participate in incident response and on-call rotations, conduct root-cause analysis, and drive durable fixes and preventative measures.

Capacity Planning & Maintenance

  • Plan for capacity upgrades, forecasting growth in storage, compute, and I/O, and scheduling upgrades ahead of demand.
  • Perform routine and preventative maintenance — patching, version upgrades, index maintenance, vacuum/compaction, backup verification, and configuration hygiene — with minimal disruption.
  • Maintain runbooks, operational documentation, and disaster-recovery procedures.

Data Analysis Support

  • Support data analysis activities by assisting analysts and engineers with query optimization, data access, and structuring data for efficient analytical workloads.
  • Partner with analytics teams to ensure Databricks and downstream platforms deliver reliable, performant access to large datasets.

Architecture & Design

A defining requirement of this role is the ability to architect data platforms that remain high-performing, highly available, and recoverable at very high data volumes.
  • Architect high-performance database designs capable of sustaining very high transaction and query volumes without degradation.
  • Design high-availability (HA) architectures — replication, clustering, failover, and multi-zone/multi-region topologies — to meet demanding uptime targets.
  • Design and validate disaster-recovery (DR) strategies, including backup/restore, replication, failover runbooks, and defined RPO/RTO targets, with regular DR testing.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into scalable, resilient, and cost-effective platform designs across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Databricks.

Required Qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on database administration experience, with senior-level depth in PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Databricks.
  • Demonstrated experience scaling data environments for very large data volumes, including sharding, partitioning, replication, and performance tuning at scale.
  • Deep expertise in database configuration, optimization, indexing, and query performance tuning.
  • Proven experience designing and operating high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions for high-volume databases.
  • Strong skills in monitoring and observability — instrumenting metrics, dashboards, and alerting to drive proactive operations.
  • Experience with capacity planning, maintenance, patching, and upgrade management in production environments.
  • Solid command of SQL and a scripting/automation language (e.g., Python, Bash) for operational tooling and automation.
  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms, storage/compute scaling, and Delta Lake / Spark concepts within Databricks.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to stay calm and effective during production incidents.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD for database changes.
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) for database and data workloads.
  • Exposure to data governance, security, encryption, and compliance requirements at scale.
  • Relevant certifications across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Databricks, or major cloud providers.
  • Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading platform initiatives.

Key Skills & Attributes

  • Technically savvy — genuinely strong and current across all three platforms, with the instincts to diagnose and optimize complex systems.
  • Highly collaborative — works closely with engineering, analytics, and product teams and communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Eager to learn and grow — curious, adaptable, and motivated to expand skills as the data estate and technologies evolve.
  • Proactive and ownership-minded — anticipates problems, prevents outages, and takes end-to-end responsibility for platform health.
  • Detail-oriented and reliable — disciplined about maintenance, documentation, and operational rigor.

Location: Charlotte, NC, Menlo Park, CA OR Ottawa, Canada (hybrid 3 days/week with up to 15-20% travel)

Salary Range: $185K - $205K base + 15% bonus and equity

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution
At Skan AI, you'll be part of the team pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Join Skan AI
We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

About the Role
The Senior Technology Architect is the senior technical authority for our most strategic and high-value accounts. You own the full solution journey — from discovery of the customer's enterprise tech environment through gap analysis, solution design, and coordinated delivery — ensuring every deployment is architecturally sound, integration-ready, and set up for long-term success. As the single technical owner accountable for architecture fit, integration design, and end-to-end solution soundness, you serve as the primary technical point of contact from contract signature through go-live. This role focuses on our Strategic & Growth customer segments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Conduct deep-dive technical discovery of the customer's enterprise tech stack and infrastructure.
  • Perform tech fitment and gap analysis, mapping the customer environment to the platform stack to surface integration gaps and deployment risks.
  • Design end-to-end solution and integration architectures covering VA deployment, gateway setup, and cloud connectivity.
  • Select the appropriate deployment model (cloud, hybrid, or on-prem) and define HA/DR and backup design patterns.
  • Present solution proposals and architecture to customer CTOs, architects, and IT leadership.
  • Coordinate testing, environment setup, and issue resolution across internal and client teams (DevOps, Security, onboarding).
  • Own architecture review and sign-off for clean delivery handoff, acting as primary technical contact from signature to go-live.

Key Deliverables
  • Customer tech discovery report with gap analysis and integration requirements.
  • End-to-end solution design documents and architecture blueprints per strategic account.
  • Technical requirements translated for implementation, DevOps, and Security teams.
  • Customer-facing solution presentations delivered to CTO / IT leadership.
  • Successful go-live: VA deployed, gateway configured, cloud integration verified.
  • Reusable reference architectures that accelerate onboarding and shorten time-to-deploy.

Required Skills & Experience
  • 12–15+ years in enterprise technology architecture, solution architecture, and client-facing technical delivery.
  • Enterprise architecture: multi-cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployment patterns with focus on Azure and GCP.
  • Integration & security: REST APIs, OAuth, SAML, LDAP/AD, HashiCorp Vault, F5, APISIX, RabbitMQ.
  • Solution design & gap analysis: translating complex customer environments into actionable blueprints.
  • Executive communication: present and persuade at CTO / IT-leadership level.
  • Cross-functional coordination: aligning DevOps, Security, and onboarding teams through delivery.
  • Strategic account mindset: high ownership, senior stakeholder management, and accountability for outcomes.

Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.

Benefits
  • Private medical and dental insurance
  • Pension / retirement contribution
  • Life assurance and income protection
  • Generous paid annual leave plus public holidays
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Hybrid and remote working
  • Stock Option Plan

Head of Strategic Accounts, Americas - New York or Menlo Park, USA

About Skan AI
Skan is a leading AI-powered enterprise work context platform adopted at-scale by Fortune 500 that helps enterprises uncover how work really happens and power their agentic lifecycle. By capturing and understanding every digital interaction at scale, Skan enables organizations to optimize operations, boost productivity, and accelerate digital transformation. Skan uniquely addresses topics that span AI adoption by the C-Suite, transformation and process improvement for technology and operational leaders and agentic deployment for automation teams across the enterprise.
Our customers include some of the world's largest financial institutions, insurers, healthcare and technology firms, who rely on Skan to surface insights that drive measurable business outcomes. If you're passionate about shaping the future of AI-driven transformation and finding new ways to grow inside accounts you already know well, we'd love to hear from you.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

The Skan AI opportunity

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Commercial Leader to build, lead, and scale Skan's Strategic Account Director (SAD) organization across the Americas. This is a player-manager role: you will manage a team of Strategic Account Directors who each own a portfolio of large enterprise accounts — spanning BFSI, healthcare, and other named verticals — while carrying overall accountability for the region's net revenue retention and expansion number.

You will hire, coach, and develop SADs; set account strategy and territory design; personally engage at the executive level in the region's most strategic accounts; and ensure the team runs a consistent, rigorous cadence of account planning, forecasting, and QBRs. You will partner closely with Sales leadership, Partnerships, Solutions, and Customer Success to make sure the Americas book of business grows predictably and customers realize measurable outcomes from Skan.

The ideal candidate has led or built a team of enterprise/strategic account managers at a B2B SaaS company or leading Agentic provider, personally carried and exceeded a large NRR/expansion number, and can operate credibly from the C-suite of Fortune 500 clients down to the account team's day-to-day execution. This is a people-leadership role paired with individual commercial ownership — you are accountable for your team's results as if they were your own.

Key Responsibilities-

Team Leadership & Talent Development
  • Recruit, hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of Strategic Account Directors across the Americas.
  • Set individual and team quotas, territory and account assignments, and career development plans.
  • Coach SADs on account strategy, executive engagement, negotiation, and forecast discipline through regular 1:1s, deal reviews, and account plan reviews.
Regional Account Strategy & Governance
  • Own the Americas strategic account book of business, spanning Banking, FSI, Healthcare, and other named enterprise verticals.
  • Establish a consistent account-planning methodology, QBR cadence, and executive sponsorship program across the team's portfolio.
  • Personally engage as an executive sponsor on the region's most strategic or at-risk accounts.
Revenue & Forecast Ownership
  • Carry aggregate accountability for the Americas net revenue retention (NRR) and expansion ARR quota, rolling up individual SAD attainment.
  • Own forecast accuracy and pipeline integrity across the team, reporting to sales and revenue leadership.
  • Identify and prioritize cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the region's book of business, including new use cases, business units, and geographies.
Cross-Functional Alignment & Internal Advocacy
  • Partner with Sales, Solutions, Value Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Partnerships leadership to align resources against the Americas account strategy.
  • Represent the voice of the Americas customer base internally, influencing product and services priorities.
  • Partner with the partnerships team to activate GSI, consulting, and marketplace co-delivery opportunities within the team's accounts.
Key Metrics for Success
  • Regional Net Revenue Retention (NRR): Aggregate NRR across the Americas strategic account book.
  • Regional Expansion ARR: Net new ARR generated from upsell, cross-sell, and new use-case development across the team's accounts.
  • Team Attainment: Percentage of SADs at or above quota attainment; team-wide forecast accuracy.
  • Talent Development & Retention: Time-to-productivity for new hires and SAD promotion/retention rates.
  • Executive Engagement: Depth and frequency of C-suite relationships maintained across the region's portfolio.
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account management, enterprise customer leadership, or sales, including 4+ years directly managing a team of 5-10 enterprise or strategic account managers.
  • Proven track record personally carrying and exceeding an NRR/expansion quota at a B2B SaaS company or leading Agentic provider, prior to or alongside people management.
  • Demonstrated success building or scaling an account management function — hiring, ramping, and coaching account leaders to quota attainment.
  • Experience engaging and influencing C-suite executives (COO, CIO, CFO, Chief Transformation Officer) at Fortune 500 accounts, with fluency navigating complex enterprise governance and buying processes.
  • Deep familiarity with BFSI and/or healthcare operating environments strongly preferred; comfort operating across additional enterprise verticals.
  • Strong commercial acumen: forecasting discipline, contract negotiation, and pipeline management across a distributed team.
  • Process intelligence, agentic AI, RPA, or automation domain experience strongly preferred.
Why Join Skan AI?
  • Be part of a category-creating company building the full agentic lifecycle.
  • Build and lead the team responsible for some of Skan's most strategic enterprise relationships, with a direct line to the C-suite at the world's largest financial institutions.
  • Join a passionate, global team united by curiosity, integrity, and impact.
  • In-office and remote work mix with global exposure.
  • Competitive compensation and equity opportunities.
Benefits
  • 100% coverage of Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Work From Home
  • Stock Option Plan

Compensation
The salary for this role is $330K-380K OTE

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

Role Description
Reporting to the Head of Growth Marketing, this pivotal role is responsible for driving revenue and brand awareness through high-impact events and field programs. The Field Marketing Manager combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, working closely with the sales team to drive demand, build executive engagement programs, and launch initiatives that scale a high-performing event marketing engine.
You’ll own end-to-end event strategy and execution, from planning through reporting, and build the infrastructure to track performance, inform decisions, and align key stakeholders. This role is ideal for a self-starter who thrives in the details but also connects the dots at a strategic level. You bring deep field marketing expertise and a passion for creating growth opportunities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own the strategy, planning, and execution of all Skan AI marketing events, including third-party conferences, field events, and ABM-focused experiences.
  • Prioritize high-impact events that engage our ICP and support ABM efforts across key verticals.
  • Manage the full event lifecycle: vendor selection, negotiation, logistics, flawless on-site execution, and post event follow-up.
  • Maintain and manage the event calendar, budget, and performance targets, and ensure all activities and leads are tracked accurately in HubSpot.
  • Partner closely with Sales to align event strategy with ABM plays and pipeline goals, maximizing conversion of high-value accounts.
  • Collaborate with the SVP of Marketing, content team, and executive stakeholders to develop impactful event narratives and presentations that elevate our brand.
  • Build and maintain dashboards to measure event performance across funnel stages, with clear ROI reporting.
  • Provide regular performance updates to senior management, with insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Support partner and customer marketing initiatives as needed.
Qualifications & Skills
  • 8+ years of experience in event or field marketing within fast-growing B2B SaaS or tech environments.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing events, from intimate executive roundtables to large-scale conferences.
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with Sales and BDR teams to ensure alignment and flawless execution.
  • Strong understanding of B2B SaaS marketing, sales cycles, and go-to-market dynamics.
  • Experience creating compelling content (decks, presentations) that aligns with event messaging and elevates brand awareness.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to balance strategic oversight and hands-on execution.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and support sales teams.
  • Proficiency in marketing automation and CRM systems, preferably HubSpot.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to measure, report on, and optimize event performance using data-driven insights.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% for events, customer meetings, and field execution.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in technology or management
  • 8+ years of professional experience preferably in customer success management, relationship management, value delivery or consulting

Nice to have

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

The Practice Leader (PL) is a senior executive role within our Customer success and transformation organization, accountable for growing and protecting customer revenues, delivering strategic transformation outcomes, and aligning Skan’s impact with the strategic goals of our clients. The PL leads a high-performing team of Customer Value Managers (CVMs) across a portfolio of enterprise accounts and acts as the primary architect of customer lifetime value, NPS, retention, and expansion. As a champion of both operational excellence and customer innovation, the PL brings industry thought leadership and orchestrates proactive, value-driven engagement across all client touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities
  • Strategic Account Leadership & Executive Engagement
    • Lead account planning initiatives aligned with customer business goals and drive the strategic alignment of Skan’s solutions with client scorecards.
    • Establish, maintain, and deepen executive relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and thought leader to executive stakeholders.
    • Map customer organizations to identify key decision-makers, influencers, and advocates for maximizing strategic influence.
  • Transformation Delivery & Road mapping
    • Collaborate with Skan’s transformation leader to participate in transformation road-mapping discussions to identify customer objectives
    • Monitor the design and execution of transformation and solutioning workshops—directly or in partnership with consulting, SI, or technology partners—to unlock new value, address operational bottlenecks, and accelerate outcomes.
    • Translate customer goals into actionable programs, ensure delivery excellence, and oversee program governance, including QBRs/EBRs, COE set-up, and executive forums.
  • Value Management and ROI Demonstration
    • Lead value management initiatives along with CVM’s to ensure that customers achieve measurable ROI from Skan implementations.
    • Develop, track, and communicate value realization frameworks that quantify business impact, linking Skan outcomes to customer KPIs and strategic objectives.
    • Enable customers to build internal business cases and secure ongoing sponsorship by showcasing tangible financial and operational benefits delivered by Skan.
  • Industry Vertical Expertise & Thought Leadership
    • Serve as an industry subject matter expert, bringing deep knowledge of customer verticals (e.g., BFSI, Healthcare, Insurance, Manufacturing) to contextualize Skan’s impact on industry-specific challenges.
    • Proactively share market perspectives, regulatory trends, and operational benchmarks to guide solutioning and drive customer innovation.
    • Develop and present industry best practices, customer case studies, and enablement materials to position Skan as a trusted partner.
  • Revenue Growth & Customer Value Management
    • Own and drive cross-sell and upsell and expansion strategies to maximize Net Revenue Retention (NRR), customer lifetime value, and portfolio profitability.
    • Manage and improve financial metrics, including NPS, NDR, churn, margins, and cost-to-serve.
    • Build strong client references, secure customer advocacy, and drive the creation of case studies and testimonials.
    • Evangelize new product features pertaining to customers vision and provide thought leadership on the impact of the same
    • Work in collaboration with the sales representatives to maintain the account playbook and strategy and revenue growth plans
  • CVM Team Leadership & Enablement
    • Coach and enable a team of CVMs to enhance their performance, impact, and career growth.
    • Establish and disseminate customer success best practices and delivery standards across the team.
    • Oversee risk management and act as the escalation point for critical customer issues, ensuring proactive and sustainable resolutions with the program delivery teams

Success Metrics
    • Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), NDR, and account growth (upsell/cross-sell)
    • Workshop and blueprint delivery, adoption of industry-specific solutions
    • Churn rates and overall customer health
    • Value realized and ROI delivered from Skan implementations
    • Number and quality of transformation workshops, case studies, and reference wins

Qualifications & Experience
  • Education
    • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field required.
    • Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.
  • Professional Experience
    • 15+ years of progressive experience in customer success, management consulting, digital transformation, or enterprise solution delivery, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or client-facing executive role.
    • Proven track record of leading customer transformation initiatives and managing multi-million-dollar enterprise portfolios in AI, automation, or process intelligence platforms.
    • Demonstrated success in driving measurable business outcomes (ROI, cost savings, revenue growth, NPS, CLV) through technology-enabled change.
    • Significant experience in designing and delivering transformation roadmaps, strategic blueprints, and customer workshops—directly or in partnership with global consulting firms, SIs, or technology partners.
    • Deep industry expertise in BFSI and familiarity with regulatory and operational challenges unique to this sector
  • Leadership & Skills
    • Strong executive presence with the ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with C-level stakeholders and decision-makers.
    • Outstanding team leadership, coaching, and people development skills—able to inspire, motivate, and elevate cross-functional teams.
    • Strategic thinker with analytical rigor; able to translate high-level goals into actionable plans and measurable results.
    • Superior communication and presentation skills, capable of leading executive forums, workshops, and value demonstrations.
    • Adept at managing complex programs, governance, and escalations across multiple stakeholders and customer environments.
    • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth, and globally distributed teams.
  • Additional Preferred Attributes
    • Experience with process intelligence, automation, AI/ML, or data-driven transformation platforms.
    • Passion for continuous learning, industry thought leadership, and driving innovation at the intersection of technology and business value.

This is a high ownership role where the outcome is yours.

You will own the full lifecycle of PaaS platform implementations for enterprise clients, from the first client conversation through launch and operational handover. You will be the primary point of contact, the internal quarterback, and the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. If you thrive in ambiguity, love building structure, and know how to hold the room with executives while also rolling up your sleeves to get things done, this role was written for you.

What You’ll Do
Own the Client Relationship
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client program leadership throughout the full implementation lifecycle (contract signing through operationalization)
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with executive stakeholders at banking and insurance organizations
  • Lead client-facing governance sessions, program status reviews, and escalation conversations with confidence and clarity
  • Guide clients through decisions, push back when necessary, and proactively surface risks before they become problems
Lead Program Delivery
  • Take full ownership of large-scale PaaS implementation programs from initial planning through operational handover
  • Quarterback cross-functional internal teams including Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Operations to deliver a seamless client experience
  • Identify risks, scope changes, and opportunities early and drive them to resolution with urgency pulling in the right team members
  • Translate complex client challenges into structured, actionable delivery plans
  • Continuously refine delivery processes, tools, and methodologies to improve efficiency and client satisfaction
What We’re Looking For
Experience
  • 6 to 10 years of experience in program or project management in a client-facing delivery role
  • Minimum 3 years delivering technology solutions directly to external clients in BFSI (banking, financial services, or insurance)
  • Demonstrated experience owning enterprise client relationships at the executive level
  • Proven ability to build delivery frameworks, governance models, and processes from scratch in a fast-moving environment
  • Working knowledge of SaaS/PaaS delivery models and enterprise systems integration
  • Comfort navigating technical conversations with engineering and product teams while keeping clients focused on business outcomes
  • A proactive communicator who escalates early and never lets surprises reach the client
  • Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to translate complexity into a clear, compelling narrative
  • A startup mindset with comfort in ambiguity, fast pace, and building something new
Education and Certifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent certification is a plus
Why Join Skan
  • Be part of a rapidly scaling AI company where your work directly shapes client success and the future of enterprise process intelligence
  • Work with cutting-edge AI and GenAI solutions that are transforming how the world’s largest financial institutions operate
  • Join a collaborative, high-trust team culture with experienced leaders in AI and enterprise transformation
  • Flexible remote work environment
  • Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

AI Solutions is our global post-sales and professional-services organization — the team that takes process intelligence and agentic AI out of pilots and into production, and owns customer outcomes end-to-end. We are AI-first by default: we spot repeating patterns and build agents to automate them, scaling the value we deliver with the book of business, not with headcount.

The role.  Set the technical bar for AI-native delivery and be the first line of defense on every solution we build. You own architecture and solutioning end-to-end — from pre-sales through delivery — and you see the whole picture: not just what the customer asked for, but why they bought us and what they actually need. You translate wants into needs, frame the real problem, and drive it from idea to implementation to impact. This is an AI-native operational-intelligence architect, not a traditional workflow or BPM architect.

What you own
  • End-to-end, AI-native architecture and integration design for customer engagements — the build patterns the whole delivery team works to.
  • The big picture — understanding why the customer is buying Skan, shaping the real problem behind the stated request, and designing to the outcome.
  • Pre-sales solutioning and the architecture gate-review before anything reaches the customer; you are the quality bar.
  • Reusable reference architectures, patterns and standards fed into the Center of Excellence.
  • Architectures grounded in operational telemetry — the digital twin of work — and built for continuous optimization.
  • Agentic systems design — perception, reasoning and planning; bounded autonomy, contextual memory, multi-agent orchestration and runtime observability.
What we look for
  • Thinks in systems, not workflows — reasons about enterprise operational behavior, not requirements → approvals → implementation.
  • Real agentic depth (well beyond 'instruct the agent' / 'let the agent decide') and telemetry-native intelligence design.
  • Sees needs behind wants — frames the business problem and drives idea → implementation → impact.
  • Fluent in AI economics — inferencing, token and GPU modeling; scalability, hallucination-containment and auditability tradeoffs.
  • Runtime governance of autonomous systems; designs adaptive human + AI operating models.
  • Challenges traditional software assumptions; AI-first by default.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate.
We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

ROLE SUMMARY
The DevOps Engineer designs, builds, and maintains the CI/CD pipelines, deployment tooling, and infrastructure automation that power Skan's customer delivery operations. Working within the Customer Ops team, this role is the engineering engine behind deployment velocity — ensuring that customer environments are provisioned, upgraded, and maintained reliably, securely, and at pace.
This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and infrastructure operations. The DevOps Engineer is responsible for making deployment a repeatable, automated, and quality-assured activity — eliminating manual overhead, enforcing DevSecOps standards, and giving the wider Customer Ops and Systems Engineering teams the tooling they need to operate efficiently at scale.
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
As Skan's enterprise customer base grows, so does the complexity of managing deployments across cloud-hosted, customer-hosted, and hybrid environments. Without dedicated DevOps engineering, deployment activities are manual, inconsistent, and slow — creating delivery risk, increasing the chance of environment-related incidents, and preventing the Customer Ops team from scaling without linear headcount growth.
The DevOps Engineer provides the automation and tooling layer that makes Skan's customer delivery operations scalable, auditable, and professionally run — directly supporting SLA commitments, deployment quality, and time-to-value for enterprise clients.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for customer environment deployments, upgrades, and patch cycles — covering cloud-hosted and customer-hosted models
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Helm, Ansible)
  • Implement and enforce DevSecOps practices across all product and client deployment pipelines — including security scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code controls
  • Develop and maintain deployment tooling, scripts, and environment templates that reduce manual effort and improve deployment consistency
  • Support Systems Engineers during new customer environment builds, patch cycles, and major upgrades — providing tooling, automation, and hands-on assistance
  • Build and maintain ops process tooling: SLA tracking dashboards, deployment status portals, environment health monitors, and internal reporting utilities
  • Maintain deployment metrics and reporting — pipeline success rate, deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate — to inform continuous improvement
  • Identify and remediate deployment bottlenecks, pipeline failures, and infrastructure configuration drift across customer environments
  • Collaborate with the SRE team to align infrastructure design with operational monitoring and incident response requirements
  • Participate in change management processes — ensuring all production environment changes are logged, reviewed, and reversible
  • Contribute to the Automation Engineering team's agentic workflow initiatives — developing automation that further reduces operational toil
  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for all pipelines, playbooks, and environment configurations
KEY DELIVERABLES
  • CI/CD pipeline designs and live implementations for all customer deployment models — cloud, on-prem, and hybrid
  • Infrastructure-as-Code templates and reusable deployment playbooks — maintained, versioned, and documented
  • DevSecOps controls documentation and compliance evidence for all customer-facing pipelines
  • Automated environment provisioning and teardown scripts — reducing manual setup time per new customer deployment
  • Deployment metrics dashboard: pipeline success rate, deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate — reported monthly
  • Ops tooling: SLA trackers, status portals, and environment health dashboards operational and actively used by Customer Ops teams
  • Target: pipeline success rate ≥ 95%; zero unplanned production outages attributable to deployment tooling failures

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution
At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.
Why Skan AI
We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.
Overview:
We are looking for a Solutions Consultant to lead end-to-end platform implementations for enterprise clients. The role involves working closely with customers to map complex financial processes, design solutions aligned to business KPIs and regulatory requirements, and ensure seamless integration within their IT ecosystems. You will be the primary technical and delivery owner  responsible for data health, issue resolution, and driving measurable value realization throughout the customer lifecycle. A strong analytical mindset is key, as the role requires leveraging data analytics, process intelligence, and AI/ML techniques to surface insights and deliver prescriptive recommendations to stakeholders at all levels. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in Python, BI tools, and consulting, with the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical teams and C-suite executives

Key Responsibilities

1.  Solution Delivery & Customer Engagement

  • Lead end-to-end implementations, spanning discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, and deployment execution.
  • Map and validate complex financial processes — including lending, claims management, customer onboarding, and compliance workflows.
  • Design solutions aligned with business KPIs, regulatory requirements, and risk control frameworks.
  • Configure and operationalize the platform within enterprise IT and data ecosystems, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with business goals.
  • Serve as the primary solution owner, accountable for delivery timelines, milestone adherence, and measurable value realization.
  • Produce executive-ready dashboards, insights, and strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders.

2.  Data Health, Governance & Technical Support

  • Act as the primary technical contact and platform expert, providing proactive guidance, timely issue resolution, and continuous support throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and lineage across multiple interconnected systems.
  • Identify and resolve data anomalies, integration issues, and process gaps, with particular rigor for audit-sensitive use cases.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams to strengthen system robustness and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Enable customer Centers of Excellence (COEs) and partner organizations through targeted training and structured knowledge transfer.

3.  Data Analysis & AI-Driven Insight Generation

  • Analyze process data to surface trends, inefficiencies, and actionable improvement opportunities.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis using advanced data analytics, log analysis, and process intelligence techniques.
  • Apply AI and machine learning to detect anomalies, identify bottlenecks, analyze process hierarchies and variants, and perform correlation and trend analysis.
  • Progress insights along the analytical maturity curve — from descriptive through predictive to prescriptive recommendations.
  • Leverage generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, and insight synthesis, with appropriate validation rigor.
  • Build repeatable analytical frameworks and reusable models to drive scalable delivery.

4.  Reporting, Visualization & Value Communication

  • Develop, maintain, and present customer-facing dashboards and performance reports.
  • Translate complex, data-intensive findings into clear, business-focused narratives tailored to the audience.
  • Communicate outcomes with equal effectiveness to technical teams and C-suite executives.

5.  Collaboration, Documentation & Advisory

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to align on priorities and deliver integrated outcomes.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of solution designs, platform configurations, data assumptions, and process maps to support scalability and knowledge transfer.
  • Enable customer teams through training programs, best practice guides, and ongoing advisory support.
Stay current with developments in AI, advanced analytics, and regulatory trends to continuously enhance delivery quality

As Sr. Principal Customer Value Management, you will be focused on unifying sales and the customer success team and will report directly to our Head of Customer Success. You will be a portfolio manager and practice leader for one or more industry verticals, leading the team focused on accounts related to these verticals. You will also have the chance to play a crucial part in all stages of the established customer relationship and have high-level monitoring control and ownership of the customer lifecycle. In addition, you will focus on driving overall retention/upsell strategy, creating frameworks for resolving customer issues, and driving overall customer satisfaction.

What You’ll Do:
  • Lead customer strategy, executive relations, provide thought leadership, Product expertise and domain consulting​
  • Build industry specific expertise on processes, Skan applicability and business problems ​
  • Provide coaching and enablement to CSM’s​ reporting to you
  • Setting and managing customer expectations ​
  • Manage risks and escalations both with internal and customer stakeholders
  • Accountable for revenue protection, customer experience and making customer referenceable​
  • Manage delivery governance across portfolio of accounts​
  • Handle 1-2 accounts directly as CSM, with a revenue potential of $1M + ​
  • Customer program governance and cadence: QBRs. Monthly, marketing motions internally​
  • Sustain business growth and profitability by maximizing value to the customer
  • Ability to uncover insights from data and present findings effectively to client leadership
  • Perform project management duties to ensure timelines are achieved in collaboration with cross-functional teams
  • Organize product demonstrations, product awareness, and discovery sessions for customers
  • Improve customer onboarding processes
  • Evaluate and improve tutorials and other communication infrastructure-related topics
  • Facilitate relations between clients and the internal stakeholders
  • Handle and resolve customer requests for accounts directly managed as a CSM
  • Work with the sales team to manage upsell and account expansion
  • Assist in recruiting and hiring, training, and developing Customer Success Managers


What You’ll Bring

Need to have
  • Bachelor's degree
  • 10+ years of professional experience managing large enterprise relationships
  • 5+ years’ experience working in a SaaS company with enterprise clients
  • 5+ years in program and project management responsibilities
  • Previous People Leadership skills and an ability to coordinate and collaborate with Field Engineering and Solution Engineering teams
  • Industry knowledge and experience in delivering Digital Transformation Initiatives
  • 5+ year’s experience in one or more industry verticals like banking, finance, insurance, healthcare
Nice to have
  • 2+ years previous start-up experience
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong organization and presentation skills
  • A propensity for relationship building
  • Passion for delighting customers with business value

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

This is a senior, high-impact seat within a small, globally distributed team working directly with Fortune 100 clients. You will join early enough to shape how this practice is built: the frameworks, the value models, the playbooks and the executive narratives that define how Skan's process intelligence translates into proven business outcomes.

For the right person, this is a career-defining role at the frontier of how AI is changing the way large organizations understand and improve themselves.

What You Will Own

Value Architecture
  • Define how Skan's process intelligence translates into measurable business outcomes for Fortune 100 clients
  • Build the end-to-end value framework: from hypothesis through proof, covering how value is identified, modeled, tracked, and demonstrated to executive stakeholders
  • Develop ROI models that are credible at the CFO and Board level, grounded in Skan's operational data and client financials
  • Establish what 'proven value' looks like at Skan and make it standard, repeatable across clients and industries

Solutions and Playbooks
  • Build the solutions catalog: repeatable use cases mapped to business functions and industries, each with a clear financial impact model
  • Create delivery playbooks that standardize how transformation engagements run without becoming consultant-heavy or bespoke
  • Develop reusable frameworks and accelerators that allow the team to move faster and more consistently, with Product, CS, and Sales actively drawing from this body of work


Executive Engagement
  • Craft the investment cases, value narratives, and ROI summaries that land in CFO, COO, and Board settings
  • Lead and support executive workshops that use Skan's live operational data to drive strategic decisions, not theoretical frameworks
  • Translate complex operational intelligence into financial language that executives act on

Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Work with Product to ensure the solutions catalog reflects where Skan's intelligence layer is headed
  • Work with Customer Success to embed value tracking into the ongoing client relationship
  • Work with Sales to sharpen how Skan's value proposition is framed and quantified pre-close


Who You Are

Background
  • 8-10 years of experience, with a meaningful tenure at MBB or a top-tier strategy firm at Engagement Manager level or above
  • Deep experience leading large-scale operational transformation or cost efficiency programs at Fortune 100 clients
  • Exposure to AI, process intelligence, or enterprise automation is a genuine advantage
  • Prior experience in enterprise SaaS, whether as an operator or advisor, is a plus

What You Bring
  • You are comfortable operating at the most senior levels of a client organization and earning trust quickly
  • You can build a rigorous financial model and walk a CFO through it in the same conversation
  • You translate operational complexity into financial language without losing precision or credibility
  • You write and structure frameworks that people use, not decks that get filed away
  • You are effective without infrastructure: no research team, no associates, no pre-built playbooks to hand off
  • You think in systems: not just solving the immediate problem, but designing how it gets solved at scale

Mindset
  • You want to own outcomes, not just advise on them
  • You are energized by building something that does not yet exist
  • You have commercial instincts and understand that demonstrated value drives expansion and retention


What This Role Is Not

  • A project management role focused on delivery coordination
  • A presales or solutions engineering function
  • A traditional consulting engagement with a defined end date
  • An execution role without strategic accountability
