Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Sr Principal / Principal Customer Value Management, you will play a strategic role in driving customer value realization and long-term success across enterprise accounts. You will own the end-to-end customer lifecycle—from onboarding and implementation to adoption, value delivery, and expansion—while acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.

This role requires a strong blend of consulting, program management, data-driven insights, and relationship leadership to ensure customers successfully leverage the platform to achieve measurable business outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Customer Value & Strategic Partnership
  • Act as a trusted value delivery partner for assigned enterprise customers.
  • Drive customer value realization by aligning customer objectives with platform capabilities.
  • Provide strategic guidance, consulting, and best practices throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Understand customer landscapes, business priorities, and transformation initiatives.

Customer Lifecycle Management
  • Own and oversee all phases of the customer journey including onboarding, implementation, training, adoption, expansion, and ongoing support.
  • Ensure customers successfully adopt the platform and achieve targeted business outcomes.

Program & Stakeholder Management
  • Lead complex customer programs in partnership with solution delivery teams.
  • Coordinate across engineering, product, and delivery teams to ensure successful implementation.
  • Build strong relationships with business leaders, technology stakeholders, and vendor management teams.

Customer Success Metrics & Reporting
  • Track and manage key Customer Success metrics including product adoption, license utilization, business value delivered, customer satisfaction, and renewals.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records within Customer Success tools and reporting platforms. Executive Engagement & Governance
  • Deliver executive briefings and strategic updates to senior customer stakeholders.
  • Drive governance activities including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), program reporting, and risk management.

Customer Adoption & Expansion
  • Monitor and drive goals around product adoption, license utilization, and customer success outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales teams on renewals, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.

Knowledge Sharing & Thought Leadership
  • Develop customer case studies, success stories, and project learnings.
  • Share insights internally to improve product, delivery, and customer experience.
  • Organize workshops and promote industry best practices.

Customer Enablement
  • Lead onboarding initiatives, change management programs, and training sessions.
  • Facilitate certification programs and workshops to accelerate adoption.

QUALIFICATIONS
What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field.
  • 12–18 years of professional experience, preferably in customer-facing roles such as Customer Success, Transformation, Consulting, or Program Management.
  • Experience working with technologies such as automation, process and task mining, business process management, workforce intelligence, or desktop process analytics.
  • Strong program and project management capabilities with experience managing enterprise engagements.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and delivery teams.
  • Strong data analysis skills to provide insights for process optimization, cost reduction, and operational efficiency.
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma principles and process re-engineering methodologies.
  • Fluency in Spanish, German or Italian

Preferred Qualifications
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation capabilities, including executive-level interactions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise customer engagements.
  • Professional experience in Financial Services and/or Insurance industries.
  • Certification or practical experience in Six Sigma or process improvement methodologies.

Key Competencies
  • Strategic customer leadership
  • Enterprise relationship management
  • Data-driven decision making
  • Program governance and risk management
  • Process optimization and transformation
  • Cross-functional collaboration

BE AT THE FOREFRONT OF THE AGENTIC AI REVOLUTION

At Skan AI, you'll be part of the team pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

WHY JOIN SKAN AI
We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
Join our diverse, collaborative team of 200+ innovators solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Here, diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and your contributions will directly transform how Fortune 500 companies operate. This is your opportunity to shape the future of work itself alongside talented colleagues who challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

ABOUT THE ROLE
We're looking for a content leader who builds and runs the engine that fuels our marketing initiatives. You'll own Skan AI's editorial voice, thought leadership program, and content function end-to-end, translating complex technology into narratives that resonate with C-suite buyers at Fortune 500 companies.
You'll set the strategy, lead the team, and roll up your sleeves when it matters- spanning thought leadership, demand generation, product marketing, social media, SEO/AEO, customer marketing, sales enablement, and executive content.
You'll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth, Sales, and leadership to position Skan AI as the definitive voice in enterprise agentic AI. You'll also build an AI-powered content operation that scales output without sacrificing quality, and develop narratives that resonate with executives, decision-makers, and the analysts and influencers who shape their thinking.
This role is for someone who has built content functions before, knows what great looks like, and is ready to do it again at a company that's defining a new category.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Narrative, Messaging & Thought Leadership
    • Shape and evolve Skan AI's core messaging framework in collaboration with product marketing, ensuring alignment with value proposition and competitive differentiation customized by persona.
    • Craft compelling content messaging and storytelling for executive and technical audiences across industries.
    • Maintain a unified brand story and voice across all channels and asset types.
    • Translate complex AI, automation, and process intelligence concepts into engaging business value stories.
    • Create keynote outlines/scripts, analyst briefs, PR statements, and executive bylines that position Skan AI as an industry thought leader.
    • Produce multimedia assets that advance our narrative in enterprise agentic AI.
  • Content Strategy, Production, Distribution, and SEO/GEO
    • Build and scale an editorial calendar spanning blogs, reports, video, webinars, and social.
    • Manage end-to-end content workflows to achieve a predictable, high-quality publishing cadence.
    • Create and package thought-leadership content for multi-touch campaigns in partnership with Growth Marketing and Demand Gen.
    • Reuse and amplify cornerstone content into shorter formats, distributing through organic, paid, and social channels to maximize reach, engagement, and conversions.
    • Continuously test and iterate distribution tactics based on performance insights.
    • Collaborate with Growth Marketing on the SEO, AEO, and GEO strategy — including keyword/prompt research, on-page optimization for GEO, and technical best practices for website-hosted content.
  • Integrated Campaigns & ABM
    • Align content with integrated and account-based marketing campaigns to drive MQA, SAL, and sales-pipeline goals.
    • Collaborate with Growth Marketing to personalize content for target accounts and verticals.
  • Customer Storytelling
    • Partner with Customer Success to showcase real-world impact through written and video formats.
  • Content Analytics & Performance Optimization
    • Define success metrics from impressions to influenced revenue; build dashboards for full-funnel visibility.
    • Run experiments and apply insights to lift organic traffic, conversion, and pipeline contribution.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
    • Partner with Product, Sales, CS, and Leadership to ensure content accelerates every stage of the buyer and customer journey.
    • Present strategy, performance, and insights to executive-level client stakeholders.
  • Team Leadership, Vendor Management & AI Innovation
    • Elevate the talent of a diverse team of writers, designers, and video specialists through hands-on coaching and continuous upskilling.
    • Establish workflows and quality standards for copywriting, design, and multimedia content.
    • Drive creative inspiration to push innovation in visual storytelling, interactive content, and multimedia assets.
    • Pilot Gen-AI-powered workflows to accelerate ideation, personalization, and production while safeguarding brand voice and factual accuracy.

  • QUALIFICATIONS
  • Required skillset:
    • 10+ years leading enterprise content programs in high-growth environments, ideally in enterprise AI, automation, or adjacent categories.
    • Deep domain fluency in enterprise agentic AI, including familiarity with how AI agents, orchestration, and autonomous workflows are reshaping enterprise operations. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to speak the language credibly with CIOs and COOs.
    • Demonstrated excellence in narrative design, content strategy, and editorial vision across the full funnel, with a track record of translating complex AI and automation topics into clear business value.
    • Proven ability to build and scale AI-powered content operations that drive measurable outcomes across organic growth, MQLs, influenced pipeline, and revenue.
    • High AI quotient: you actively use AI tools in your workflow, have run Gen AI content experiments, and can build or direct AI-assisted content systems, not just describe them.
    • Deep expertise in SEO/AEO/GEO, multi-channel distribution, and performance analytics.
    • Experience aligning content with demand generation and ABM campaigns for enterprise sales cycles.
    • Skilled people leader and stakeholder manager, adept at hiring, coaching, and cross-functional collaboration.
    • Proven agency management experience across PR, brand, design, video, and localization, including managing retainers, briefing creative partners, and holding external teams accountable to quality and timelines.
    • Prior success publishing or ghostwriting for executives across analyst briefings, keynote addresses, and industry reports.
  • Nice to have:
    • Familiarity with enterprise operational AI, agentic automation, process intelligence, process mining, task mining, or intelligent automation markets.
    • Experience customizing content for BFSI, healthcare, or other regulated enterprise verticals.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

We are seeking an Agentic Solutions Manager to own the delivery, deployment, and expansion of Skan’s agentic AI platform at our most strategic enterprise accounts. In this role, you will be the single point of accountability for customer outcomes — leading complex implementations, building trusted relationships with VP and C-suite stakeholders, and driving measurable business value from day one.

This is far more than a delivery role — it is an opportunity to shape how the world’s largest regulated enterprises adopt agentic AI, act as the voice of the customer back into our product, and build a high-performing team as the function scales.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Delivery & Deployment
  • Own End-to-End Delivery: Take full ownership of 2–3 concurrent agentic AI deployment programs at Tier-1 enterprise clients, from scoping and stakeholder alignment through execution and value realization.
  • Be the Client’s Trusted Advisor: Serve as the primary point of accountability for VP and executive-level client sponsors, ensuring transparent communication, proactive risk management, and consistent delivery against committed milestones.
  • Navigate Complexity & Ambiguity: Operate effectively within large, regulated organizations where requirements evolve, stakeholders multiply, and clarity must be created — not inherited.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Execution: Coordinate internal teams — Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Sales — to deliver a seamless and integrated client experience.
Account Growth & Expansion
  • Identify and Drive Expansion: Spot and develop opportunities to broaden platform adoption within existing accounts, partnering with Sales to build the business case and convert opportunities into new revenue.
  • Deliver Executive-Level Business Reviews: Lead QBRs and executive briefings that quantify value delivered, surface insights, and frame the path to deeper engagement.
  • Think Like an Owner: Approach every account with a growth mindset — you are not just delivering what was sold, you are shaping what gets sold next.
Product Feedback & Strategic Influence
  • Close the Customer-to-Product Loop: Synthesize patterns across engagements — friction points, feature gaps, workflow opportunities — into structured, actionable input for Product and Engineering leadership.
  • Champion the Customer Internally: Ensure the voice of the customer is heard in product roadmap discussions, sprint planning, and strategic prioritization.
Team Building & Leadership
  • Player-Coach from Day One: Lead by doing — personally delivering strategic projects while setting the quality bar, playbook, and culture for how Skan shows up with clients.
  • Build the Function: As the business scales, hire, mentor, and manage a delivery team, establishing repeatable processes and a standard of excellence for customer engagement.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years in a client-facing, delivery-oriented role with at least 3 years in a high-growth startup environment (Series B–D or equivalent stage).
  • Consulting Foundation: Background at a top-tier management consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or equivalent) is strongly preferred — we value the structured problem-solving, executive communication, and workstream leadership this develops.
  • Executive Presence: Demonstrated success engaging with VP and C-level stakeholders at large, complex enterprises. You are comfortable being the most senior person in the room from your side of the table.
  • Domain Knowledge: Experience in financial services, insurance, or healthcare is a strong plus. Familiarity with process mining, intelligent automation, or AI/ML platforms is valuable but not required.
  • Semi-Technical Fluency: You don’t need to write code, but you need to understand agentic AI architectures, SaaS/PaaS delivery models, and enterprise integration patterns well enough to lead technical conversations with credibility.
  • Growth Orientation: A track record of identifying expansion opportunities within accounts and partnering with Sales to drive revenue growth.
  • Location: Based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco or New York. This is a hybrid role with regular in-person client engagement expected.
  • Skills: Exceptional communication, structured thinking, and the ability to build trust quickly across cultures and organizational levels. A natural problem-solver who thrives in ambiguity.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 Days: You’ve taken ownership of your initial accounts, built trusted relationships with client executive sponsors, and delivered a clear plan for each engagement with defined milestones and success metrics.
  • First 6 Months: Your accounts are on track or ahead of plan. You’ve led at least one executive business review that quantified delivered value and surfaced an expansion opportunity. Product and Engineering leadership view you as a reliable, high-signal source of customer insight.
  • First 12 Months: You’ve successfully delivered 2–3 strategic deployments with measurable client impact. You’ve directly contributed to account expansion revenue. You’ve begun building the team — hiring your first direct report and establishing the delivery playbook that will scale with the business.

Why Join Us

  • Growth & Impact: Be part of a rapidly scaling company where your contributions directly shape client success and open clear pathways for career advancement.
  • Innovative AI Platform: Work with cutting-edge agentic AI solutions that transform enterprise workflows while upholding the highest standards of security and trust.
  • Build Something: This isn’t a mature function you’re joining — it’s one you’re building. You’ll have direct influence over how Skan delivers, grows, and evolves.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a global team that values innovation, learning, and partnership, guided by experienced leaders in AI and enterprise transformation.

We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to design, build, and operate secure, scalable cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role combines deep cloud engineering expertise, DevSecOps practices, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and strong Linux system administration to enable reliable CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and security-first platform operations. The ideal candidate will be passionate about automation, platform reliability, and embedding security throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure across Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Develop and operate CI/CD pipelines with integrated DevSecOps security controls.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Implement and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) including RBAC policies, service accounts, and identity federation.
  • Embed security best practices such as secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and policy enforcement.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization of cloud environments.
  • Monitor platform health, troubleshoot production incidents, and lead root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with development, security, and platform teams to improve deployment velocity and system reliability.
  • Maintain documentation, operational runbooks, and engineering best practices.

Required Skills & Experience

(Must-Have)

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or related roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) including networking, GKE, virtual machines, storage, DNS, and secrets management.
  • Proven DevSecOps experience including shift-left security and integration of SAST, DAST, and SCA within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, including troubleshooting production workloads.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Harness, including YAML pipelines, variable groups, and environment configurations.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform including module development, state management, and workspace strategies.
  • Advanced Linux system administration including performance tuning, network diagnostics using tcpdump, kernel parameter tuning, and cgroups.
  • Strong scripting and automation using Bash and Python.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir, and Alertmanager.

(Good-to-Have)

  • Experience designing multi-cloud or hybrid cloud architectures including cross-cloud networking.
  • Exposure to cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices including usage monitoring and resource optimization.
  • Experience with enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as PostgreSQL, StarRocks, and Apache Flink.
  • Experience implementing Identity and Access Management frameworks including RBAC, SSO, OAuth, service principals, and identity federation.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborating across engineering teams.

Soft Skills

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams and mentor junior engineers.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.

This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with an expectation to work from the office three days a week.

Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced PostgreSQL DBA to manage and optimise highly loaded PostgreSQL databases handling large volumes of data. The role involves ensuring database performance, availability, scalability, and reliability across self-managed and cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Administer, maintain, and upgrade PostgreSQL databases across environments
  • Manage high-volume and high-traffic databases with large datasets
  • Monitor and optimise performance, queries, indexing, vacuum, and auto vacuum
  • Define and manage connection thresholds and pooling.
  • Implement and manage backup, restore, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Design and support replication, read replicas, and high-availability setups
  • Understand and apply sharding and partitioning strategies when required
  • Manage schema migrations using Alembic
  • Understand and evaluate Liquibase vs Alembic usage
  • Support PostgreSQL in self-managed (on-prem) and cloud environments
  • Good troubleshooting skills.
  • Helps in design schema and make sure things are in order.

Required Skills
  • 5–10 years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern data warehousing tools (e.g., Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, or similar platforms).
  • Experience with large-scale, heavily loaded PostgreSQL databases
  • Strong knowledge of backup & recovery, replication & HA, performance tuning, and connection management
  • Hands-on experience with Alembic
  • Working knowledge of Liquibase
  • Experience with Linux-based systems

Nice to Have
  • Experience with cloud-managed PostgreSQL (Azure / GCP)
  • Familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools
  • Basic scripting skills (Python / Shell)

Soft Skills
  • Strong troubleshooting and ownership mindset
  • Ability to handle production issues
  • Clear communication with engineering teams

This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with an expectation to work from the office three days a week.

Data Analysis and Visualization
  • Customer-Centric Dashboards: Collaborate with customers to design, build, and refine Power BI dashboards that transform complex data into clear, actionable insights, demonstrating ROI and performance improvements.
  • KPI Development and Tracking: Develop and monitor customized key performance metrics and KPIs (e.g., Net Promoter Score, First Pass Rate) tailored to customer needs, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Advanced Data Mining: Conduct advanced data mining and analysis using SQL and data warehousing techniques to uncover trends, correlations, and insights that drive business improvements.
  • Operational Insights: Analyze operational datasets to discover deep, actionable insights that deliver measurable value to customers, enhancing process efficiency and effectiveness.

Collaboration and Value Engineering
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Data Science teams to identify data-driven process improvements and innovate new value drivers from Skan.ai’s platform.

Data-Driven Decision Support
  • Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into compelling, data-driven stories that support strategic business decisions and enhance customer outcomes.

  • Dashboard Expertise: Demonstrated ability to create intuitive, user-friendly dashboards that effectively communicate process insights to diverse audiences.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

Who are we looking for

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Software Developer (Python) with 5+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and deploying Python-based microservices. The ideal candidate should have expertise working with cloud-native architectures using Docker and Kubernetes, and integrating services with Large Language Models (LLMs) via OpenAI APIs. You will contribute in design, development, and deployment of scalable services while working in an agile/scrum environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Contribute in design and implementation of Python microservices hosted on Kubernetes or Docker environments.
  • Develop and maintain python micro-services where communication between microservices uses RabbitMQ OR similar queue based services
  • Contribute is design and optimize database schemas; implement data access layers using PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
  • Integrate LLM capabilities via OpenAI or similar APIs into microservices.
  • Write unit, integration, and system tests; ensure code quality and maintainability.
  • Track work progress and maintain up-to-date tasks on Azure Boards (or similar work item tracking systems).
  • Contribute in peer code reviews using Git-based tools (Azure Repos, GitHub, or similar).
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Required experience:
Programming Skills:
  • Strong expertise in Python (3.x), with knowledge of best practices for building scalable services.
  • Application of proven programming principles and patterns
  • Prompt engineering skill to generate code using Cursor, Co-Pilot or similar tools.
Design Skills:
  • Strong expertise in OOP with Python.
  • Good to have expertise in code design /modelling skills using UML or similar tools
Frameworks/Libraries:
  • Experience with popular Python frameworks – SQL Alchemy, Alembic
  • Experience with building custom python packages.
Containerization & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (AKS or self-hosted).
Messaging Systems: Proven experience using RabbitMQ for asynchronous service communication.
Databases:
  • Relational: PostgreSQL (schema design, performance tuning).
  • NoSQL: MongoDB (data modelling, CRUD operations).
APIs & LLMs: Integration of microservices with LLMs or OpenAI APIs; handling authentication, request/response flows, and prompt engineering basics
In-depth Knowledge and Experience in the following areas:
  • High level understanding of following tech stack
  • Source control with Git (Azure Repos, GitHub).
  • Familiarity with container registries (ACR, Docker Hub).
  • Work item tracking and task management using Azure Boards (or Jira).
Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies, including sprint ceremonies, story point estimation, and continuous delivery.
Additional skills:
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting / debugging skills.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design principles.
  • Familiarity with observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing) is a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to lead technical discussions and present solutions effectively.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Certifications related to Kubernetes, Azure, or Python.
  • Exposure to implementing security best practices for containerized workloads.
  • Experience working with AI/ML pipelines or model deployments is a bonus.

Education:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with an expectation to work from the office three days a week.

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

Why Join Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Join our diverse, collaborative team of 200+ innovators solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Here, diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and your contributions will directly transform how Fortune 500 companies operate. This is your opportunity to shape the future of work itself alongside talented colleagues who challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

About the Role

We're seeking an experienced VP, Product Marketing to lead our product marketing function and drive Skan AI's market positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy. You'll be responsible for establishing Skan AI as a category leader, building comprehensive product marketing infrastructure, and ensuring our value proposition resonates across every customer segment and use case. This role requires category creation expertise, deep technical fluency in enterprise AI and automation markets, and a proven ability to execute at the pace of a fast-moving AI company scaling into its next phase of growth.
Ideal candidates have 12+ years of product marketing experience, including at least 5 years in leadership roles, with proven success in positioning, messaging, analyst relations, and go-to-market execution for enterprise technology companies. You'll work cross-functionally with executive leadership, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to own Skan AI's market position and drive product marketing excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Positioning & Messaging
    • Define and own Skan AI's positioning, messaging architecture, and value propositions across all products and solutions
    • Develop compelling narratives that differentiate Skan AI's approach and resonate with target buyers
    • Craft executive messaging for board presentations, conference keynotes, investor communications, and customer engagements
    • Drive competitive strategy and maintain competitive intelligence across the market landscape
  • Product Marketing Foundation
    • Build and maintain core product marketing assets including persona templates, value propositions, messaging hierarchies, use case libraries, battle cards, and ROI frameworks
    • Develop comprehensive sales enablement including pitch decks, demo scripts, objection handling, discovery frameworks, and sales plays
    • Collaborate with content marketing to create high-impact assets: whitepapers, solution briefs, data sheets, demo videos, webinars, and customer stories
  • Analyst & Industry Relations
    • Own analyst strategy and all interactions with key industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, Everest Group, IDC)
    • Lead analyst evaluation processes including positioning strategy, customer reference coordination, and briefing preparation
    • Translate analyst insights into actionable sales and marketing assets that strengthen market credibility
  • Go-to-Market Execution
    • Own end-to-end product launch strategy and execution for new products and capabilities
    • Develop industry-specific positioning that translates platform capabilities into vertical value propositions
    • Partner with Product and Revenue teams on pricing strategy, packaging evolution, and market expansion
    • Build customer marketing programs including reference development, case studies, and advocacy cultivation
    • Translate product roadmap into sales-ready positioning and enablement, and partner directly with sales enablement to keep training current and build real excitement in the field
    • Work directly with customers to surface real, marketable use cases, and own the feedback loop back to product so what customers actually need shapes what gets built next.
  • Market Intelligence & Customer Insight
    • Lead market research to validate opportunities, understand buyer personas, and inform product strategy
    • Establish systematic voice-of-customer programs through interviews, win/loss analysis, and customer feedback loops
    • Maintain competitive intelligence on market trends, competitor moves, messaging, and positioning
    • Synthesize insights to inform product roadmap and go-to-market priorities
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Team Building
    • Present regularly to executive leadership and the board on product marketing strategy, market dynamics, and business outcomes
    • Partner with Sales, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure alignment and execution excellence
    • Build and scale the product marketing function through hiring, development, and process optimization
    • Foster a culture of customer obsession, strategic thinking, and data-driven decision making
  • Qualifications & Skills
    • 12+ years of product marketing experience in enterprise AI or complex enterprise technology platforms, including at least 5 years in leadership roles
    • Proven track record in positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution for enterprise technology companies
    • Deep expertise in enterprise sales cycles with Global 2000 companies
    • Demonstrated success in analyst relations, with measurable improvements in positioning and market perception
    • Strong technical fluency, with the ability to understand complex enterprise technology and translate it into business value
    • Expert-level proficiency developing go-to-market strategies, positioning frameworks, and messaging architectures
    • Outstanding executive communication skills, with experience presenting to C-suite, boards, and large audiences
    • Exceptional writing ability across strategic documents, sales enablement, web copy, and thought leadership
    • Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams
    • Equally comfortable leading a board presentation and rewriting a sales deck at 9pm before a big demo
    • BA/BS degree; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred
  • Nice to Have
    • Experience specifically in agentic AI or automation platform markets
    • Background in product marketing during high-growth or market inflection phases
    • Established relationships with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, Everest, HFS, etc.)
    • Speaking experience at major industry conferences
    • Experience with pricing and packaging strategy
    • Track record of successful category positioning or market leadership initiatives

Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.
